Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We scared off Lauren Boebert. Last year, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical seat and replace Lauren Boebert in Congress? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79470734/456558875/1610638071?refcode=em20240221pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ac54bdfd-15d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzU0YmRmZC0xNWQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4wGpZiprpZU3SdDq7VGibBAULpKcELIzgtfWlGBdA1A=)

For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We scared off Lauren Boebert. Last year, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected it this early – or for the other side to go after my family. Thank you for being on this journey with me, through thick and thin. With gratitude - Adam P.S. I love you, Dad and little sis. ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. | | | Peter, We’re just two months away from the hotly-contested Democratic primary challenge to Rep. Summer Lee, and we're starting to see her opponents ramp up familiar attacks to defeat her. **Just this week, the first TV ad of the cycle went on the air, and *surprise* — it's a scaremongering attack ad against Summer Lee.** Attacks like these aren’t new for Summer — she fended off similar attacks to win her seat two years ago. But this year, Republican-funded groups like AIPAC are pledging to spend $100 million or more to try to oust her and other progressive members of Congress with attacks like these. **That’s why it’s critical that we have the resources we need to counter their attacks and reach voters now.** [**Can you split a contribution between Summer Lee’s campaign and WFP to help us get our message out and mobilize voters in key races like this one?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUVsD6ML4br4Gklpqg9GLoMFT_ZZDJaxKwZ2ktDsIxuAbd_sK0wRx7wGS18BQG1T715XUWvw3SCaQQ_T5xrUwjYuJa2qCrCQkK0ypV_lxzfEKbMkNxGb9BG3UaNShwVk2rVM1LYzIfLNinGS2l1RluYDWfnQcTUjkdl0yLAolygXRJ81XEqE1MpnxdgKr2LMcvkL42uHqte38d4Pl9aC67IosrTHYS9xpCFZZmsHV_48dKV1pciolTlH8lmkivYQnCBz6MrGUVC-Fvd3h3wpB1BvY7BHI8Z08etjvlCQXMY-vUpKieMHP7ZL0LVX162JV5fAcfzOhmSlN_ivWY6DYzlyU5o-uAe3_puyMMDLkhplhRoWn79b1Hnzqug5QSNm3l712Q5KKX4FH_wNf8c77_HHffFfV30mgUw8BIXcj--gU/442/zHdigtUuRiGop5_kLzFzNA/h0/ucF8qw5tznJ1c_QhMX35f1n9vjjer0PCrq_jtcoq9Yg) **[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUVsD6ML4br4Gklpqg9GLoMFT_ZZDJaxKwZ2ktDsIxuAbd_sK0wRx7wGS18BQG1T7183WBclBpDJpJswOJBKfUWZOSWY8aoohpmKWU3gGjR2tc5AUkGRPUB-GQQaUA_D63luhDLW9xyQ7hbzEwzbuvYdlV51Lri7JTqc-eZGWF_UqU34fcD22mnGs34-FtRq1-jzqsBjeMbEB4FpwnjLxy9DJeHMt-CKynHJhIA7GIfWN-HmtQVB7lD1e3VLB51BgqHUNqf9mJBWKZYUvK1Ld82PjiVYdpzJgh3dlz9-WJDPB-mZsH22IjaDqTFjQc8mMzXHu0ewSZbMxGDSF2LoIH8BakG-7bJPhQhLO7N5tiM1vHwgH_AkDxvlq7ZyUaAQsL04YMjwDLlOaPyXVaw47RvugmG0kndh3Ph9lg9BtLbic/442/zHdigtUuRiGop5_kLzFzNA/h1/ft-RB8QJcW-nWIEPE7nEBuOsZyLstq_ePpYHJVkvxPI)** We can’t let AIPAC and the right-wing billionaires who fund them succeed in their plan to decimate the ranks of progressives in Congress and put MAGA Republicans in control of all levers of government. Summer Lee, and we're starting to see her opponents ramp up familiar attacks to defeat her. Just this week, the first TV ad of the cycle went on the air, and surprise — it's a scaremongering attack ad against Summer Lee. Attacks like these aren’t new for Summer — she fended off similar attacks to win her seat two years ago. But this year, Republican-funded groups like AIPAC are pledging to spend $100 million or more to try to oust her and other progressive members of Congress with attacks like these. That’s why it’s critical that we have the resources we need to counter their attacks and reach voters now. We can’t let AIPAC and the right-wing billionaires who fund them succeed in their plan to decimate the ranks of progressives in Congress and put MAGA Republicans in control of all levers of government. We need to stand up for Summer and every WFP champion in Congress, and counter every attack these extremist forces throw our way before the first primaries which start in just a few weeks. That might not mean matching them dollar-for-dollar, but it means raising enough so that we can get our own message out to voters. The good news is that WFP champions like Summer Lee represent the interests of their constituents, not billionaire Republican donors. We’re planning to spread that message — through phone banks, text banks, door-to-door canvasses, TV and digital ads, and postcard campaigns. When I look outside my window at the screaming mob, I only grow more resolved and committed to fight for what’s right. This is disgraceful – but I won’t back down... | | | | | Fellow American, For the second time this week, far-left agitators have come to my house early in the morning chanting hateful slogans, ringing bells, and shouting at the top of their lungs. They claim to be protesting Israel’s actions in Gaza, but their real goal is to wake up my neighbors, harass my family, and attempt to intimidate me. I won’t be intimidated by these lefty malcontents and their liberal paymasters- but I need your help to stand strong and fight back. Will you chip in right now to let me and my family know you’re with us? >> Sadly, this is now common in American politics thanks to the far-left non-profits that fund political agitators seemingly everywhere on every issue- we see protesters blocking traffic, interrupting campus speeches, screaming hatred on the streets, and even attempting to vandalize artwork in museums. Now they’ve come to my home... ** Why is this happening? Because the left isn’t able to tolerate any dissent. And the far-left has always used physical violence and intimidation in order to put pressure on their political opponents. Now this tactic is common in within the Democratic Party. It’s wrong. Please know that I’ll never bow to these disgraceful tactics. I’ll stand strong for Texas and the United States of America- always. When I look outside my window at the screaming mob, I only grow more resolved and committed to fight for what’s right. Thank you. Abortion bans have thrown this country into crisis, and it’s going to get worse before it gets better. We have to be clear-eyed about what we’re up against: Extremist Republicans weren’t done after the _Dobbs_ decision, and **politicians like Marsha Blackburn won’t be satisfied until a federal abortion ban is in place.** It doesn’t matter to them that women are left suffering with miscarriages while doctors decide if they’re sick enough to save, or that girls are forced to travel out of state to receive abortions after rape. But I’m fighting back — and it’s not just talk. Here in the Tennessee legislature, I introduced a bill granting an exception to our state’s abortion ban for children under 13. My Republican colleagues voted it down without a second thought. subject: Asian American Community Outraged Over Racist Attacks On Dave Min
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/58acf1984e40/asian-american-community-outraged-over-racist-attacks-on-dave-min-15670840?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** February 21, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Asian American Community Outraged Over Racist Attacks On Dave Min**

_"As Chair of ASPIRE PAC, I'm outraged by the racist attacks on Dave Min.”
\- U.S. Representative Grace Meng

“This vile attempt to cast doubt on Dave Min’s credibility by employing yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not only overtly racist but also perpetuates harmful stereotypes that have no place in our political discourse.”
-Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen_
**IRVINE, CA** — Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) leaders are expressing outrage over a recent political mailer targeting Asian American State Senator Dave Min. The mailer, funded by a dark money PAC supporting Joanna Weiss, has drawn sharp criticism for its racist undertones and attempts to discredit Min's integrity. The mailer's use of a yellow tint over Min's photo, coupled with baseless accusations of untrustworthiness, not only reeks of bigotry but also resurrects the vilest stereotypes from the annals of history. This insidious "Yellow Peril" rhetoric, perpetuated by Weiss' PAC, seeks to portray Asian Americans as perpetual foreigners, unable to be trusted, and is reminiscent of the darkest chapters of discrimination in our nation's past.

**"As Chair of ASPIRE PAC, I'm outraged by the racist attacks on Dave Min,”** said Congressmember Grace Ming, Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’ Political Action Committee ASPIRE PAC. “**Using yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not just racist, it's an insult to our community. These tactics will backfire with the 20% AAPI voters who live in his district. We stand against such bigotry and call for accountability. Dave Min deserves better, and so do we all." **

“**This vile attempt to cast doubt on Dave Min’s credibility by employing yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not only overtly racist but also perpetuates harmful stereotypes that have no place in our political discourse,”** said Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen.**“Let me be clear: these tactics are not only repugnant but also an affront to everything we stand for as Democrats and as decent human beings. We will not stand idly by while our communities are targeted and vilified.”**

This is not the first time Weiss' campaign has resorted to characterizing Min using harmful anti-Asian stereotypes, raising serious concerns about her ability to properly represent the sizable AAPI community in Orange County. [**In a letter published**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=26df4d8601&e=7017cc100e) on January 29, 2024, members and leaders in the AAPI community in Orange County expressed frustration over Weiss' campaign tactics, “we are tired of so-called allies in anti-racism resorting to the language of “othering” to discredit fellow Democrats.”

The letter emphasized the harmful effects of such rhetoric, which portrays Asians as "perpetual foreigners" and "inscrutable Orientals" who cannot be trusted. It underscored the historical context of such stereotypes, which have led to discriminatory laws like the Chinese Exclusion Act and the wrongful prosecution of Asian American scientists.

Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c02c1706f5&e=7017cc100e).
###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

| | **For Immediate Release:** February 21, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Asian American Community Outraged Over Racist Attacks On Dave Min**

_"As Chair of ASPIRE PAC, I'm outraged by the racist attacks on Dave Min.”
\- U.S. Representative Grace Meng

“This vile attempt to cast doubt on Dave Min’s credibility by employing yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not only overtly racist but also perpetuates harmful stereotypes that have no place in our political discourse.”
-Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen_
**IRVINE, CA** — Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) leaders are expressing outrage over a recent political mailer targeting Asian American State Senator Dave Min. The mailer, funded by a dark money PAC supporting Joanna Weiss, has drawn sharp criticism for its racist undertones and attempts to discredit Min's integrity. The mailer's use of a yellow tint over Min's photo, coupled with baseless accusations of untrustworthiness, not only reeks of bigotry but also resurrects the vilest stereotypes from the annals of history. This insidious "Yellow Peril" rhetoric, perpetuated by Weiss' PAC, seeks to portray Asian Americans as perpetual foreigners, unable to be trusted, and is reminiscent of the darkest chapters of discrimination in our nation's past.

**"As Chair of ASPIRE PAC, I'm outraged by the racist attacks on Dave Min,”** said Congressmember Grace Meng, Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’ Political Action Committee ASPIRE PAC. “**Using yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not just racist, it's an insult to our community. These tactics will backfire with the 20% AAPI voters who live in his district. We stand against such bigotry and call for accountability. Dave Min deserves better, and so do we all." **

“**This vile attempt to cast doubt on Dave Min’s credibility by employing yellow-tinted photos and depicting him in a money suit is not only overtly racist but also perpetuates harmful stereotypes that have no place in our political discourse,”** said Asian American Action Fund Chair Albert Shen.**“Let me be clear: these tactics are not only repugnant but also an affront to everything we stand for as Democrats and as decent human beings. We will not stand idly by while our communities are targeted and vilified.”**

This is not the first time Weiss' campaign has resorted to characterizing Min using harmful anti-Asian stereotypes, raising serious concerns about her ability to properly represent the sizable AAPI community in Orange County. [**In a letter published**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b4bb8e9801&e=7017cc100e) on January 29, 2024, members and leaders in the AAPI community in Orange County expressed frustration over Weiss' campaign tactics, “we are tired of so-called allies in anti-racism resorting to the language of “othering” to discredit fellow Democrats.”

The letter emphasized the harmful effects of such rhetoric, which portrays Asians as "perpetual foreigners" and "inscrutable Orientals" who cannot be trusted. It underscored the historical context of such stereotypes, which have led to discriminatory laws like the Chinese Exclusion Act and the wrongful prosecution of Asian American scientists.

Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=affa512ff6&e=7017cc100e).
###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

body:
Special interests and their shady, dark-money backers are doing everything they can to keep me out of Washington for good.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38051%2E3422442%2EORvLPB)
Derek, a crypto super PAC that began running a flat-out-false ad attacking us last week has put even more money behind their negative ad.
**This super PAC is spending $7 million attacking us.[Is there anything you can give right now to help us respond?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240221-3?refcode=em20240221-38051&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38051_3422442_ORvLPB&akid=38051%2E3422442%2EORvLPB)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240221-3?refcode=em20240221-38051&refcode2=38051_3422442_ORvLPB&akid=38051%2E3422442%2EORvLPB)
Independent fact-checkers at the Sacramento Bee have deemed this ad false, but these crypto billionaires don’t care. Special interests and their shady, dark-money backers are doing everything they can to keep me out of Washington for good.
Super PACs routinely meddle in races, and frankly—they often get their way. **Their prize is a politician who is beholden to them for decades to come.**
These billionaires know that if I’m elected to the U.S. Senate, I’ll be a fierce advocate for consumers, crack down on tax cheats, and prioritize our planet over their profit. **To them, $7M is a small price to pay for a California Senator who they’ve seen bend to the will of big corporations time and time again.**
That’s not ever going to be me. But while $7M might not be a lot to these few billionaires, it is a lot of money for our campaign. **Our only choice is to ask supporters like you to help us fight back. I wouldn’t ask if there weren’t still time to turn this around: 17% of voters are undecided as of a poll released this week, and less than 5% of ballots have been returned.**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240221-3?refcode=em20240221-38051&refcode2=38051_3422442_ORvLPB&akid=38051%2E3422442%2EORvLPB)
Thanks so much for being on our team,
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240221-38051&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38051_3422442_ORvLPB&akid=38051%2E3422442%2EORvLPB)**

Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**

Friend,

I never thought I'd find myself saying this, but MSNBC was right about something.

But before I explain, let me introduce myself.

My name is Brent Bozell, and I'm the Founder and President of the Media Research Center (MRC).

**The MRC is the only conservative organization dedicated to exposing the radical left-wing agenda in the media and holding them accountable for their corruption and lies.**

Friend, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 to STOP media bias and corruption.

[Can I count on you to join the fight by sending an urgent gift today? Click here to send your support >>>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2i2hiqhb9arkilgmadfrn3u3u6hc30q95g1qjqo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30slie9or7c9h2bs)

So... How on Earth did MSNBC get something right for once?

It starts with the recent attack on two NYPD police officers by illegal immigrants in broad daylight in Times Square. Despite the dangerous and heinous nature of the crime, _the attackers were set free the very next day_.

Even the left-wing media was FORCED to admit the crisis at the border has gotten out of control.

MSNBC's Joe Scarborough admitted:

**_" Revolving doors aren't a solution! Letting somebody beat the hell out of a New Yorker one day and be walking out on the street the next!? That's a recipe for chaos."_**

Yes, it is indeed a miracle that MSNBC actually got something right!

_I never thought I would say those words in my life_.

But, in classic MSNBC fashion, the moment of clarity didn't last long. Scarborough couldn't help but add his radical leftist spin, claiming the proposed immigration bill is the solution.

Pathetic.

**These criminals were literally given a "get out of jail free" card.**

How did we go so wrong that New York is now on "the front lines" of our border crisis?

The answer is the media have LIED to the American people about the crisis unfolding on our southern border, and we now find ourselves in a dangerous crisis that threatens our Republic.

Make no mistake about it: the immigration bill being pushed by the media is a reckless piece of legislation that will NOT solve the border crisis.

The bill is an empty promise to the American people.

It's a political ploy and an insult to people on the front lines like those officers in New York.

**But if all you knew about the bill came from the leftist national media, you 'd assume the bill would fix everything!**

This is just ONE example of the blatant bias the media bombard our country with every day.

And for every story, like the attack in New York, they ignore countless others.

**This is why we do what we do: to hold the media accountable and force them to confront the realities of the Left 's radical policies.**

In recognition of the single day these criminals were held accountable by MSNBC, we are raising $24,000 to support our ongoing efforts to hold the media's feet to the fire _every day_.

[Donate Now](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh667q1odufpofupk3iuhvscb9c17t5iu5s19v4o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30slie9or7c9h2bs)

The border crisis, like countless other stories, is something they'd rather sweep under the rug.

**We refuse to let that happen.**

**HOW THE MEDIA RESEARCH CENTER DEFEATS THE LEFT**

Since 1987, the Media Research Center has worked successfully to expose and counter the leftist bias of the national news media, where now only a historically low 32% of Americans say they trust the media to be fair and impartial.

**STEP 1:** The MRC monitors and clips videos of all content from major networks, social media accounts, and news outlets. They have over 925,000 hours of video stored on secure servers covering every nightly broadcast and more going back to 1987.

**STEP 2:** My team and I analyze this content and identify fake news stories, lies, and media bias.

**STEP 3:** MRC's team exposes these lies by forcing the media to report the story, sharing their reports on social media, and telling the truth. The MRC also owns some of the largest social media pages in the conservative movement so that they can share these stories with supporters.

**The left-wing media is already gearing up to lie to us about the 2024 elections. I do believe they will try stealing the election with their lies and bias. We need to hold them accountable.**

When the MRC was founded in 1987, over 80% of Americans trusted the left-wing media. Since then, MRC has successfully SHATTERED America's trust in the left-wing media -- roughly 70% of Americans state they DO NOT trust the media anymore.

I am confident we'll do the same to expose censorship from other media, Big Tech, and the government.

Your support will make it possible.

Thank you,

Brent Bozell
Founder & President of MRC

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zuko1frkst9jqm4nor64hn29kmc7i99g661jlb3g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdg68ob4c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

body:

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znfdhmvtovnrn2k44uesd8hcdrtpaafs60bfp9t8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdg68ob4c3h2bs)

| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: we need to be prepared. . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

If you ever wanted to know just how critical young people are to the Abortion Lobby’s plans for 2024, just consider Vice President Kamala Harris.

She’s actually copying my national tours by going on one of her own, hitting multiple college campuses in presidential Battleground States!

Of course, the similarities end there as the goal of the Vice President’s tour is to target young people with lies about abortion and radicalize the pro-abortion mob against pro-lifers like you and me!

Pro-Life Friend, with everything on the line in 2024, we can’t afford to let Vice President Harris get away with that unchallenged.

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ has created our own **_Rapid Response Team_** to protest Vice President Harris’ copycat tour, ensure the pro-life message is heard at her events, and change hearts and minds of young voters.

But with her next stop being **TOMORROW, Thursday, February 22nd,** in Grand Rapids, Michigan where she’ll appear with the abortion-in-all-nine-months queen Governor Gretchen Whitmer, I need to come up with the resources that our team will need **_ASAP_!**

The good news is, we have PLENTY of young people ready and eager to hit the road whenever needed to stand up to the Abortion Lobby.

BUT I CAN'T DO IT WITHOUT YOUR HELP!

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s Rapid Response Fund_ to help us respond to Vice President Harris’ tour](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, Vice President Harris has become the poster child for the Abortion Lobby’s extreme late-term abortion-on-demand agenda.

As a U.S. Senator, Vice President Harris even voted against the _Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act,_ which would've simply required that babies who are born alive after a botched abortion receive medical care.

No wonder she’s one of the Abortion Lobby’s favorite people.

They’re clearly the ones pulling the strings on this tour.

Whether it’s hosting “sex weeks” on college campuses with events like _“Intro to Sex Toys,”_ and _“Valentines for Abortion Providers,”_ hijacking middle school sex-ed classes and teaching children that _“virginity is completely made up,”_ or Vice President Harris’ so-called “Fight for Reproductive Freedoms” tour, the Abortion Goliath’s goal has been clear:

_“Target young people. Lie to them. Make them radically pro-abortion.”_
That’s why your immediate support is so critical!

If we can get our **_Rapid Response Team_** of dedicated students to turn up at every single one of the Vice President’s tour stops, we’ll expose her lies and speak the TRUTH about abortion to voters – _even changing hearts and minds at her events!_

But with her next stop being **TOMORROW,** I’ll need your immediate help to make that happen.

**[So, please make a generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s Rapid Response Fund_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-j/)!**

**–** A **[gift of $50 or more to our _Rapid Response Fund_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-i/)** could pay for some pizza for the entire team – which is always a great reward for our students!

**–** A **[gift of $100 to our _Rapid Response Fund_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-d/)** could cover the cost of any signs and supplies our students would need during their protests.

**–** A **[gift of $235 to our _Rapid Response Fund_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-h/)** will cover the cost of gas for our students who drive across the country to hold these protests.
Or, if you’d like to generously cover the cost of ONE of our student’s protests in its entirety, a **[one-time gift of $335 to our _Rapid Response Fund_ would do just that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shhyddd-duchtdja-k/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

| Peter, A common question we hear at TFVC: “So what does TFVC actually DO?” We exist to protect vaccine choice and medical privacy, but we act this out in many different ways! TFVC may be best known for its work in the state capitol: every other year, the Texas state legislature meets for five months beginning in January. Before the session we write legislation to advance our medical rights and during the session we spend hundreds of hours in Austin working with legislators to pass those bills.
Another huge part of our operation at the capitol is _killing_ the bad bills. Dozens of bills that would threaten your vaccine choice are filed every session. As soon as we find one of these bills, we educate voters all over the state and help them contact their elected officials to fight against these bills. **Because of the activism of thousands of Texans,****each and every bill TFVC has opposed has been stopped from becoming law!**

---
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Educating about our medical rights and helping Texans stand up for themselves and their families is so rewarding! Did you know Texas allows for multiple vaccine exemptions for children? At TFVC, we field dozens of calls from parents with questions about this process. We help with these exemptions at _no cost_ to the family in need. We have also been working to help Texans navigate vaccine mandates from COVID-19 policies - helping people keep their jobs and their paycheck!
People like you often look to TFVC for information about where candidates stand on the issue of vaccine choice. We help educate Texans on the good and bad guys. **And we are proudly non-partisan.**

---
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Protecting vaccine choice and medical privacy is **critical** to our rights as free Texans. We are blessed to work with Texans everyday on matters that affect our rights in every way. YOU should call the shots!

name: Restore Our Nation
subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/a2V91CeEw8ZaEFwniCfKQQ~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/a2V91CeEw8ZaEFwniCfKQQ~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/a2V91CeEw8ZaEFwniCfKQQ~~/AARclAA~)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

## Court Rules Frozen Embryos are Children
The Alabama Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos have the [same legal protections as children](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb_G7oiGARtcULwmXV67pTWYIWEFwcIkUf5-la23u1enOTpfl_VCKaf79T8Vdj3WlbaenryiQBSoVz0GF5mR1chOGrCzxEnb8eaklDJq4wFMiAFZoeEQgTSoeQpWjckhoAZElDDNcjkt3iMvEXmyZCUugwYOqdd2-q7p3m8c87s-uZ22Wsbsbr3vx6D-DXge8Ez7nV_HB31O62nL_FmZPBUSx2NvXFhs9dG6iK0WwcW3dz2EnKVaIIKZrAdNZlaWMQQmhBDNRmNzYX-lnNMxm0HDtVDKvw79zyI_AQAA__8XumCx) under state law. The case involved lawsuits by three couples over the accidental destruction of their frozen embryos. The justices cited language in the state Constitution granting parents the right to sue over the death of a minor child as the basis for their ruling. ["](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAUheGnMZuRfTAEBg9d2NK1I7LhOrmViZFxQHn7Kpm7neFIn_T_XKer48iP27dbyZaQJjcXPmiCBCTMZKrFBiJQU5HVF9V3Gq3pq7vVrW91uCA0DQXnfGugfa-0xjJ41bmKLRSMAqBV2-mhHrwHDQHU9q7XGIRRtHBJuf5N_Ch3CvGVDsr1nNYq2nsp2y6aL4FRYDzPs95S5MJzeh8Exgedu8D4VgRGhc8WGF103q1O7s8t00pyTs9cJK0-v9Iu-QhSKW3QNH2V7bKdHCPv3UUYdVsdxw9f_o3xFwAA__-5o13q)_[Unborn children are'children'](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAUheGnMZuRfTAEBg9d2NK1I7LhOrmViZFxQHn7Kpm7neFIn_T_XKer48iP27dbyZaQJjcXPmiCBCTMZKrFBiJQU5HVF9V3Gq3pq7vVrW91uCA0DQXnfGugfa-0xjJ41bmKLRSMAqBV2-mhHrwHDQHU9q7XGIRRtHBJuf5N_Ch3CvGVDsr1nNYq2nsp2y6aL4FRYDzPs95S5MJzeh8Exgedu8D4VgRGhc8WGF103q1O7s8t00pyTs9cJK0-v9Iu-QhSKW3QNH2V7bKdHCPv3UUYdVsdxw9f_o3xFwAA__-5o13q). . . without exception based on developmental stage, physical location, or any other ancillary characteristics,_" Justice Jay Mitchell wrote in Friday's majority ruling. Critics said the ruling would [impact fertility treatments](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2u4yAUhJ8Gd8eCE_xD4WJTuFgp225pYfsQ2MVgAY6VPP2Vb32rKUYazff9fUwP7bwLzz96o6GYOOmluBdNCIiAcpLVOhgipFtFg-h43wpsZF_ZgbpukRJ71SCXhnMllRRt28u1WZQUVLkBOUqOiII3rVC1mmckZZCaXvcCFZOcVldiqv9FF4ol49_xRale4lb5wZayZ3b7xXBkOJ7nWW85XB3DkQIcmeFoSftiGY6xWEoMR-31rDcNNubdFe1hP0qGXR-ZIAZwLwMuwKn_E0QD6bjYIev3FSbFDwWgbU7vmEEngsU6vyYK13KC-124cf_9qdKw7qfz3uW2Y5I_N-389-vyo8OvAAAA__8au3Qy) in the state. A hospital at the University of Alabama at Birmingham has already paused in-vitro fertilization treatments as it evaluates the decision.
## Ballerina Arrested by Russia for Treason
Russian authorities arrested and charged [Ksenia Karelina](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb1hwwQQGhi7e0rWjdTbn-CqMI6Cx8vdVOnd9b3l6X7fphpw43z9xp9DWY8Kl8ZMmkAASzGS6GFYioEtHQV-VsxoG47otWGPQKm0RVDTOqtk7sqsnWKK-eKU6DqDAKADQarDa936egfwKNDh0GrwwiiK3o_TfB-e20Zpex5NKvxx7l8LW2qOKy4eAUcB4nmef5yXTWd9ewJj5vrX0km8kYHxypEPAiDsVXjDLGVOiwhkllkK1UZScZfmplVGCMoPTfrh6rbsS4uPklLjaqzDqviOnv4j275LfAAAA__-b-GHX), a 33-year-old woman with dual Russian-American citizenship, with treason for allegedly donating $51 to a Ukranian support group. The Russians claim that Karelina, an amateur ballerina, participated in pro-Ukraine rallies in the U.S. as well as contributing the money. If convicted, she could serve life in prison. _"I do think he is giving [a middle finger] to the United States and to the Americans, "_ said Bill Taylor, former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine, who said [the arrest was a message from Putin](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQhX-N2Q7hwxAYGBqpbOnaERl8Tq4xNrJNUP99ReZOT09P-vT0fd-mm2bH_v6lVxqyDZNeMr9oQkAEVJMqzGCJkOqCBnmpulZio7riMSw16s7ivCjZquUym7ZpbNMbqnspZ2UKHrBCVSGirJpW9mU_z0i9RWo63UnsharIcA6x_Ans84Os-w0viuUS1sINj5y3JOoPgaPA8TiOck3-3ASO5GFPAkdPxxlHiM4IHHWMlDIEC2bXDvYEcU-JtYdZO0eRvYZnIs8anjqSOzsn2PbMHhKsbIwjsOzvFCGHE2B4c2HV-U2H61Xy5xNzEQezHewcp_YiVHVfNbv37_yvxb8AAAD__24qdgQ), Meanwhile, [the White House](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnsTcsOIONB4Yu2dK1o3WGc7gKQ4RpovTpq3bu_A-_9H1c1yty4nx7x4Nc28uKvvGDVhAAAvSq--B2IqCxJ6dmaScFRts-OqXIaLJmHMM0gwnj5v2syVuPMHlLPTuQoCUAKGkmtQzLtgEtO5CxaBUsnZYUuJU6fBbOLdKeXuVBdfDl6JOLrd3Pbnzr4NLBJdPzHF4YS_nNHVzwoMoes9gwJaqcUYQvTMJz42_KZ-S7wFrpbBSElNJIY40ZYjtSX124PzklPqe50_J2IKe_a_vX4CcAAP__sfReCw) says it's monitoring the situation. National Security Spokesman John Kirby told American citizens traveling in Russia: _" You ought to leave right now."_
## Poll: Parties Divide On Views of Industries
American perspectives on U.S. industries are deeply divided along partisan lines, [including higher education, news media, and energy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFv8yAUAH-NvWHBC2AzMERfZH0d0qFV1dHC-Dl5FQYLSKL--6qZu55uON3neTo7ChQvr25DW9c0OV_pjhMwAAZyku1iV0TAQ4tW9HzQApQc2qvVZkYn_HBQ3K-gZ6cE9wNo0_eopFpbssBBcgAQXGlhOjPPgGYFVIMbBJhGclyoptx9JYr1imv4TnfMnU9bG-y11r00h2MDYwPjnkot3T3lFBO5ff-VnjhQJV8aGP-nBzsldsIt-exqYS4u7A332xzIu1jYiBjYcU63yv5hro4i-3hnL3G5lZoJC9NGtNku-4NCoKL7RvLL5ig8g-qfe34CAAD__yyGZ9U), according to a new YouGov survey of 1,000 Americans. On average, Republicans are neutral toward higher education, while Democrats are very positive. Republicans have a far more favorable view of the oil and gas industry than Democrats do. [You can see a visualization of the results here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOhCAQgOGnwU4DsyxKQXGN3V57pRlx2J0LigHU7Ntf7urr_-RPvq_H9ECOvD0_cSVXQ5rQVz5pghagBT3pZnGBCOjWkFO9HIyCux6alzNkBhnA98qG3vR98N7SbC1JPSuzYMMOJGgJAErejbKdnWcgG4DuAw4KrNCSFq4pd9-Jt_qiEN_ppNz5tDbRvWrdi7h9CBgFjNd1dSeXA6PHnStGLvU3FDAepeVtOUrN7zbgmTLOHLm-24XW5DPW0mbajzmyx60IGJvslv3iGLmYXmj5XJHj37X-a_ATAAD__3XtYGc) The biggest divide is over the news media, where Democrats are modestly positive while Republicans are deeply negative. body:

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=291da7a74e204565b178b8027ea444df&_e=C5oE753ABgz0EQI2EstlYCY_KlkTcJHpBD9YInWupih8ZYb9_LNQ5kPSc6GoGVwLuFiS7FsFh8nQcE75VtfzH5aWqL7vOhNN-TXD-E74UfCUq6INCWIjfQnGuOu2vfv_kJgVi74CCvisWEL1s39o5QdIAVgH51U3ohCuIWZV2nhPM3tIBSrqVoCXAMCpzhFekmu6J1KXBmfRN5LS640jxCcZJ04rmjnIyPHOLEnCyL7c3DoHDA_rk_y9jNDXnwGwt2rzpel2tEMhQLkGwEvzllB5-dsDoNQYbCnEF-kCz5yXCtFqsklyRQXtkLQ3yG5l)

Friend,

I never thought I'd find myself saying this, but MSNBC was right about something.

But before I explain, let me introduce myself.

My name is Brent Bozell, and I'm the Founder and President of the Media Research Center (MRC).

**The MRC is the only conservative organization dedicated to exposing the radical left-wing agenda in the media and holding them accountable for their corruption and lies.**

Friend, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 to STOP media bias and corruption.

So... How on Earth did MSNBC get something right for once?

It starts with the recent attack on two NYPD police officers by illegal immigrants in broad daylight in Times Square. Despite the dangerous and heinous nature of the crime, _the attackers were set free the very next day_.

Even the left-wing media was FORCED to admit the crisis at the border has gotten out of control.

MSNBC's Joe Scarborough admitted:

**_" Revolving doors aren't a solution! Letting somebody beat the hell out of a New Yorker one day and be walking out on the street the next!? That's a recipe for chaos."_**

Yes, it is indeed a miracle that MSNBC actually got something right!

_I never thought I would say those words in my life_.

But, in classic MSNBC fashion, the moment of clarity didn't last long. Scarborough couldn't help but add his radical leftist spin, claiming the proposed immigration bill is the solution.

Pathetic.

**These criminals were literally given a "get out of jail free" card.**

How did we go so wrong that New York is now on "the front lines" of our border crisis?

The answer is the media have LIED to the American people about the crisis unfolding on our southern border, and we now find ourselves in a dangerous crisis that threatens our Republic.

Make no mistake about it: the immigration bill being pushed by the media is a reckless piece of legislation that will NOT solve the border crisis.

The bill is an empty promise to the American people.

It's a political ploy and an insult to people on the front lines like those officers in New York.

**But if all you knew about the bill came from the leftist national media, you 'd assume the bill would fix everything!**

This is just ONE example of the blatant bias the media bombard our country with every day.

And for every story, like the attack in New York, they ignore countless others.

**This is why we do what we do: to hold the media accountable and force them to confront the realities of the Left 's radical policies.**

In recognition of the single day these criminals were held accountable by MSNBC, we are raising $24,000 to support our ongoing efforts to hold the media's feet to the fire _every day_.

[Donate Now](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=291da7a74e204565b178b8027ea444df&_e=C5oE753ABgz0EQI2EstlYCY_KlkTcJHpBD9YInWupih8ZYb9_LNQ5kPSc6GoGVwLuFiS7FsFh8nQcE75VtfzH5aWqL7vOhNN-TXD-E74UfCUq6INCWIjfQnGuOu2vfv_kJgVi74CCvisWEL1s39o5QdIAVgH51U3ohCuIWZV2nifhfNidX2BDqDRip7kma_0ElOIGDPMb-QbwgjIFQYlHrLj8-nBTad3Sv5d2bN0SphqChMknL_vbr69IIFF3BRwDU-kqD2-GMjr4KYWFzMTL82lVjC9oH9NZsFPyUHkcZrcfl9zuYL5cYmCatLK4z_d)

The border crisis, like countless other stories, is something they'd rather sweep under the rug.

**We refuse to let that happen.**

**HOW THE MEDIA RESEARCH CENTER DEFEATS THE LEFT**

Since 1987, the Media Research Center has worked successfully to expose and counter the leftist bias of the national news media, where now only a historically low 32% of Americans say they trust the media to be fair and impartial.

**STEP 1:** The MRC monitors and clips videos of all content from major networks, social media accounts, and news outlets. They have over 925,000 hours of video stored on secure servers covering every nightly broadcast and more going back to 1987.

**STEP 2:** My team and I analyze this content and identify fake news stories, lies, and media bias.

**STEP 3:** MRC's team exposes these lies by forcing the media to report the story, sharing their reports on social media, and telling the truth. The MRC also owns some of the largest social media pages in the conservative movement so that they can share these stories with supporters.

**The left-wing media is already gearing up to lie to us about the 2024 elections. I do believe they will try stealing the election with their lies and bias. We need to hold them accountable.**

[Donate Now](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=291da7a74e204565b178b8027ea444df&_e=C5oE753ABgz0EQI2EstlYCY_KlkTcJHpBD9YInWupih8ZYb9_LNQ5kPSc6GoGVwLuFiS7FsFh8nQcE75VtfzH5aWqL7vOhNN-TXD-E74UfCUq6INCWIjfQnGuOu2vfv_kJgVi74CCvisWEL1s39o5QdIAVgH51U3ohCuIWZV2niE6ufQuI_fl6XBumP02A4zqeQKs1IBlaoXrOX5f-mFmvTLMyaMeMjJPhV4K6H1VAquQWNmGuUTvLzdljUKBrGG4YySMlNTHjGdJS4sEmNGrKKUE_mpsR5Fu95qLvjR1OCTqxjbSYY_2U4eW4Z4amHz)

When the MRC was founded in 1987, over 80% of Americans trusted the left-wing media. Since then, MRC has successfully SHATTERED America's trust in the left-wing media -- roughly 70% of Americans state they DO NOT trust the media anymore.

I am confident we'll do the same to expose censorship from other media, Big Tech, and the government.

Your support will make it possible.

Thank you,

Brent Bozell
Founder & President of MRC

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d97d5509042498a89fbf9b70696bc3c&_e=WVo37UTY0bgP54uQ4PqpJBwalk4moO16durjcHdMwuCd-vhmOJG64WVI-2kxKQDHK6c2_WKUk3dIIwSn12Efy4bfKoHUCdybLAhCjqSEwMit2BR-vZK0W7tsbitLqwGhc3VMw5EHW47f8ji7xgLxUWXm46tz6TxsbcS2PoB9_FNrdBRMGa-FYnN735c8qcEYpGdwpyBemo4WtZ40mW_hINR-4Y3IKrOUUGZspmVmeSEN3uf8lXufTDEpnPiQjSmcQy208XCaE8MhPfPWhwJ1lHoBybtLAb2WhPPqoXUf5EdroZkT3V-O-kCpz5S0YUbFPkEj2uUf7Xtt7VB0OTSL_6QM0vXXA_DX6aycb0NIO9MUKSiVo22rX2P5twhpYCWFx90J8y1n7tnPEA1VfrYD2yzIjzzSHfUkyt6o0ix1FRA%3D)

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

| | Peter, Hoisting the flag of surrender.

My name is CAPT Hung Cao - in 1975 my family and I fled communist Vietnam.

The American Dream saved my family's lives, and ever since, I have made it my mission to serve this great nation and pay our debt off in FULL.

After graduating from the US Naval Academy, I became a Navy Special Operations Officer in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia, defusing IEDs and diving deep in the ocean for national security.

After 25 years of service, I decided to hang up my uniform and return home to my wife and kids. Upon my return, I realized we were facing a battle right here, in our own backyard.

Peter, despite their political talking points, we are being put LAST. As we all get poorer, the people in Washington are only getting richer.

I’m running for U.S. Senate to bring the radical left’s self-serving and FAILED agenda to a screeching halt.

**Chuck Schumer, Tim Kaine & Joe Biden aren’t taking my declaration of war lightly. Every day Americans deserve a voice, and unlike the 2-faced phonies in DC who’re tied down to the will of special interest groups, NO ONE is pulling my strings.**

# U.S. Taxpayers are Funding the Invasion of our Southern Border
---
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
The Biden administration has nearly tripled the amount of U.S. Taxpayer money going to the United Nations International Organization for Migration (IOM), which then gives cash to people who are entering our country illegally.
You heard that right: We are funding our own invasion!
A well-researched [article in Epoch Times](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qg2plk6hnb7CzGT-QefZxQPoWFNt4YRz63DYz_4NVDfovb5985dElSL8oq_iPJbagUE0o6AiYkaL4OsdgRcEQyLAUoPo-mdbzUhDKnPV0Q-nGnTEVhzxWL0j0F3y9sVs1R756suMUtWzRkMoh8Bec3viNODOR4q6T0KlMGSAAKNVpgqnRGT3JH4-n9R2V7qbj61i-4XkTMAPo_7CkR4iq13EEcYPeHTvPzHcF13t568vn3LTgi1_FpyDQZsDYybxPwbYui4WbWYWWKOFssrjD_wh2gCb3GByeim4n3CSa1v4Ef0KNwIS6jMkLBEmcxP5UeEuXMCXdnHo27YrNJ1QkESyEdSAspfXO_fTR4oSDSDe0FN9OdVr5bUvbnd7PDQmXFxA8-dFM7X235jXcrTCm5OidF4Wakrac2ORHDugF0tlvM_QHT9vU7eu9YjGXu6NTEQqL62QWilhrn4lx15mgHUM5r3pQLT-52y83sFQ6FIx3xPvxFViNw9S1YM44djCZKgepBFmHNhMLVT1z6rTyScpNH8za5KJgasmKpwTCe8=&c=-l15liO-3QJKCl5yb26yJoKuTzYEVIrDrqNuwDwT3Z9hUICD1GK66g==&ch=ECW1WaPkovViZ1sfnt5n2081GBpXuHNGhl63d2lhcGFc-GyGMLXwBw==) chronicles the flow of American tax-payer money. Here's how it works:
* The U.S. State Department and the U.S. Agency for International Development give money to the United Nations.
* The United Nations keeps some of that money and then gives the remainder to non-government organizations (NGOs).
* NGOs keep some of the money and then give cash and prepaid credit cards to people traveling through Central America and Mexico to enter our country illegally.
* These people, intent on breaking our laws, keep some of the money and then give the remainder to Mexican Cartels.
* Mexican Cartels use the money to finance human trafficking and drug smuggling operations. This includes the rape and exploitation of women and children along with the production and distribution of fentanyl, which is killing Americans.
The ties to Biden are undeniable. The head of the U.N. Agency doling out these funds, Amy Pope, served as President Biden's senior adviser on migration. Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas served on the board of an NGO that is reaping millions of taxpayer dollars.
Crime, chaos, corruption, and cartels sponsored by the Biden Administration. All the while, our very own Dina Titus proudly proclaims that she is "Ridin' with Biden." It is time to end the Democrat's policies of "Americans last." We must stop the insanity!

Please forward this email to your friends and neighbors and encourage them to support Mark Robertson in his fight to take back our country.

When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and _still_ struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local donut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making donuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**
[**That's why I'm asking you to chip in just $10 — about the cost of a dozen donuts — to send me to the Senate. name: Shift WA
subject: FWD: Rally for the citizen’s initiatives right to be heard!
body:
Did you get a chance to read the previous email?

Under public pressure from people like you, Democrats have finally agreed to hearings on three of the six citizen initiatives sponsored by "Let's Go Washington." Ahead of those hearings on Feb 27th and 28th, supporters have planned an important opportunity to make their voices heard!

**_Please consider joining Let 's Go Washington supporters for a rally TOMORROW at noon on the Capitol Building steps._**

If you plan on attending, we want to hear about your experience at the rally! Send your photos from the rally to [info@shiftwa.org](mailto:info@shiftwa.org) - we may feature your photo in our weekly Sunday email!

Make no mistake, Democrats have only agreed to hear three of the initiatives after facing intense public pressure. We here at Shift WA work hard to ensure that the public stays informed about what's really going on in Olympia for just this reason!

**_[We need your help to keep going- our efforts depend entirely on the contribution of grassroots supporters like you. Please consider contributing $100, $50, or even $25 today.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62841068:Ws-OhciFN:m:1:2610672541:63D5727B83CBA81D823FB8559632B2F4:r)_**

Thank you,

The Shift WA team
Democrats have agreed to only hear three of the six initiatives on February 27th and 28th. Unfortunately, their constitutional duty remains unfulfilled for the other three initiatives. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62841069:Ws-OhciFN:m:1:2610672541:63D5727B83CBA81D823FB8559632B2F4:r "Shift
Washington")
---
| Friends,

As you likely know, the Secretary of State officially certified signatures for all six "Let's Go Washington" initiatives to the legislature back in January. However, despite that certification, majority Democrats have neglected their constitutional duty to allow all six initiatives to be heard and acted on for weeks now.

Thanks to persistent pressure from the public (and Republican lawmakers), Democrats have finally agreed to hear three of the initiatives on February 27th and 28th. The initiatives to be discussed include I-2113 (allowing police pursuits), I-2111 (banning all future income taxes), and I-2081 (ensuring parental rights in K-12 education).

Unfortunately, the Democrats' constitutional duty remains unfulfilled for the other three initiatives, including I-2117 (repealing the carbon tax), I-2124 (allowing employees to opt out of the state-run long-term care tax), and I-2109 (repealing the state income tax on capital gains). The Democrats don't want to hear from the voters on these three initiatives, but citizens will have the opportunity to voice their opinions on all six this November.

_**To highlight public support for hearings for all the Let's Go Washington initiatives, an Olympia rally is scheduled this Friday, February 23rd, at noon on the Capitol Building steps.**_

We encourage you to attend and make your voice heard.

For those planning to join, Shift WA would love to see your experience at the rally. **Please email us your photos from Friday to **[**info@shiftwa.org**](mailto:info@shiftwa.org)**. We may feature your photo in our weekly Sunday email!**

Thank you for your ongoing support,

The Shift WA team

| [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62841070:Ws-OhciFN:m:1:2610672541:63D5727B83CBA81D823FB8559632B2F4:r)
---
|
This message was intended for: [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com) and sent from Shift Washington. If you would like to send this message to some of your friends, you can [click here](http://click.shiftwa.org/forwardthis/ft.php?mID=14433214&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&ch=49000b887de404a22f48ed48dd2d4356&schema=echo3) to do so.

You can also stay up to date on our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/shiftwa/) & [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShiftWA). If you believe you received this message in error or no longer wish to receive emails from Shift Washington, [click to unsubscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/p/oWs-OhciFN).

After all, the UN’s stated purpose is to “maintain international peace.” _What a joke._ According to reports, [a dozen people](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXKRKufomSaCloQooc9rTvUanCT9ogxXbq3IGg-N0SEF-BKUeGJSe4_x2v6TF58BXMHaFyiNJM3_BJps5VkYUp6VWqdhmZqXEc20_POlbn_TaJnnLC3CIJByozkZFsgpGxQhQSeKI8HS6c6_UJtLlSCC84ycaEgq5BNc8I0_UL9ZESEC7ZEASJlchTAraOfh0E8MpqZR9EAvaLe3q9L3_TF849MkXVgc5Hn5tL-QUAGLLnSPyLFhsGN538lIIiqTiJSCAEol2I6Q1vHJcMitF1tQ%3D) from the agency were directly involved in the horrific attacks on our friends in Israel on October 7. But it gets worse: another [1,200 employees](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXMIBCh6m-12O726xS_fDne-jHdYDzy8PomA01zAVdfJ4qMpckol52AtlDHD68CD5-qdVcyPTaR0QLKpEQAHM2mPv8f8pXuPVf3Brbb9ncLgRAReFjsuTan9_qsTa3xAYkUPtxTC2jZjYNtq4uTjdmcN9fb1HkWZ6i9Z5xDiwPZwEWWrX2Ge-VSFgnUMv0CybpJwMqeTYbkSl4kHGZSoePjy19V-0uxlM4QAVYbZyIJqwOMV_uRxR0WzqoebPbJ3cdP84JpESkXPwtmRwbJZZS0lWmN2BpfpGZF2-bJM4Nxl33R0stUqz9IAcw6FTqLXcQw%3D%3D) of the agency have direct connections to Hamas—and surprise, surprise, a [Hamas compound](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXGFmGFoD8TmdpltXeJ6dgvhKrtf7S4SLGFzrHrtS0MtZ6CG_7dHAVqYDgF48272FjDVhw1VJGbhY259l3rp0mjqHnakmIsKdAiBgLlCXJVGCq83a26Pb2UmK-5acmx7cPB0rr1vFnLkQZGwSDyqhQhhqo_tRXGV4NjM__5gipO81sQj6CZCpOERlLz_OmdKqG3JKsBC85WDmnojeFFGNaGW5b9mOVAd7g7yVgn2XTZ-XDZ0IN6hm2qoOoBksBEhiDnHrYK8_aiyBR86_WsgO42PoqL3l1ziU9YaV050SKx6U) was found right underneath UNRWA Gaza headquarters. This isn’t the first time we’ve been down the rabbit hole with the UN, but it should be the last. In fact, President Trump [ halted funding](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXFZ5JhiWhX3CEW38YyOAxmyrn7jF6ATvQd3a1-81s69s2dc53E4blI2aWUf0JnnOqylJz50cTddnEEPnxqVsKF2bFanuhdbQnBmV6VmeNkeLqr7F_53EinxyNukJ4JAN2hazNrorpSVpQhi0sEgPtZXDw4iEFFVVR3ql-s2oGKMucsYk4yQxXYaB5kZhRsSCjtulquHs_AOt8KlBpzrEo_wsY5Aolf4Z9YoeCvBU9dLHaVvoX4dwOAXvO3KjiqkrAZUFM24ZIwkpua_rZRdYlmcldGXKIfhn9eJSC23aD8_5AfvreLXaangCLL37w_6Vvg%3D%3D) to the agency years ago—only to have the Biden administration rev up the engines again in 2021. **As usual, Democrats don’t do their homework to ensure the cash they freely give stays out of terrorists’ hands, and it’s a disgrace.** Yes, the U.S. State Department said it was “extremely troubled” by the latest development and has [paused funding](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXOG5apGYwFD3Ex--XNHrVrSry82v1dlH7Iyjl-rS1KZbOrjKWmpfOj0bU8gRKuNNCoIhlu5C76TRbJzy8Imy3NVvIBYKqB-D1naD3RbPecmcsDs2l5EuUiZlWGGCv5saJ4s3WmYoYpybVVmO0NXtgld5oiFzD-fgBNOhtJHk6rJIhgJYpb-DMcvIrb2B4EqRAdlrZ8QuEhS86fkXX886oj8R-BVPkPjhlc0tbzt14n_lPF0s8I-UGqU16cHgeSk8D9t3jIyb8fFgAgFYUWwF0ey2eHTzYsvwUW8Yqe7E1bc8) for the agency. But is that enough? The U.S. is the biggest donor to the agency, providing it with at least [$730 million](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXJU2BoDndotNhxVDrJ_UZtdE2kw47dwLlAWiOt_41XhUZWXIRw8Bja1CwL5Pas6vmRdyvjOXyAoP7Cox0ysbm6vX5SrOLUlHBxC6wEaBBzbdKzPMcxolEblVGH11C6UhzmI-NF0TD6kWHnwfFgCKqKz2JDHqs6-spqllfetR5IneKtTdRa_z5Ra8-doVmLAu9jPc_wfgOsh-GwG2H6KszIxIS77sgd2_j-FfMo9526w8VE3tRr0PJg083BL3rVKnLPzWA80HVGlVuRHSyov0QpMUKOd6dsbm4vxCymQ8w71rE9TmhFXO6XjpPYqjU9OsfA%3D%3D) in taxpayer dollars since 2021. But they’ve proven they can’t be trusted, and God knows our country is already spending money we don’t have at an alarming rate.
The writing’s on the wall here, folks. The UNRWA is an arm of Hamas that needs to be [dismantled](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4258b497baf744b79d6191550cb1b157&_e=I_QK_vF2q7oMcgY6or0oXIUK2l3liOJ8nU3vnDYKgnBYwDw0R9roYVTs2DOzh_M8xrX52zwQRReNUwQmuX_97OV6hFjdHl3zl7sjPTaagg2qE_TzL5CPrQurkmIBGXOddLGrPVJ7jmMwFMlklX1rXaTgwzu4vuhogl8c9HF4YzgiW5eCff-Se6TqfxfjrFnfiP7ojydSr0yz7AhfR3UcEY3WbecDhsxQxVFgfltXuLuIwaj93ci8AROLwt6-OLb2hATJxMa-L0FtEByHMKRMHEF25w9f12BTUs3DcfblIfx61DUuqgMlEXjDq3H13UgJWUiYvWerDD6wBt9gsn5GIuiWesIOQP0zMrpvucl9J3BwGwK0AqG4VSxc9qM9KchO2XkyFQBCpkcGzN7Cw8Xj0g%3D%3D), and it’s time to rethink our relationship with the UN—for good. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1156%2E135344%2EG-8PSF)

Friends -
It's the end of February, and that means if you're anything like me you're seeing non-stop requests for money from political campaigns and organizations. And as you have likely seen, there are some striking similarities in these emails and the tactics they use:
There's the 3x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240222-1-700&t=2&akid=1156%2E135344%2EG-8PSF)
The 5x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240222-1-700&t=3&akid=1156%2E135344%2EG-8PSF)
And even the 10x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240222-1-700&t=4&akid=1156%2E135344%2EG-8PSF)
Here's the thing: none of that is real. No one is matching donations. They are trying to trick people into donating. It's cynical, and it's something we're never going to do here.
Instead, we're going to be up front. And the truth is a February fundraising deadline is not an official deadline. There's no post-February FEC report that we need to fill out.
But we do have very real February fundraising goals. And right now, we are very much behind where we need to be with time running out.
Almost all of the donations our campaign receives comes from people giving smaller donations — often in response to emails like this one. But that means we have to ask.
And while I don't expect you to donate to every email we send, I hope that you will contribute to this one. It's an important time for our campaign, as we head into the rollercoaster of the election year.
[**With all that in mind, can you please use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today? There's no matching donation, no super-donor ready to 10x your contribution—but it will help ensure we win this Senate race in Michigan and probably the presidential campaign in the state, as well.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240222-1-700&t=5&akid=1156%2E135344%2EG-8PSF)

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWJsrici6N
ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWJsrici6N

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62845728:WJsrici6N:m:3:2532013465:26A7DD7012CDA35EE1D4EC3D28BF2A3D:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

# 🚨 Help us Secure our Republican Majority in the House with
# Maryland's 6th District 🇺🇸
Dear Peter,
Time is of the essence, and I'm reaching out with an urgent message about the critical state of the race for Maryland's 6th Congressional District.
As we continue to gain ground, it's become clear that the old guard—candidates in this race like Dan Cox and Neil Parrott—are feeling the heat. They know we're a threat, and they know we're working tirelessly to shake up the Republican status quo in Western Maryland.
It's no secret that Republicans need a champion—a candidate who not only talks the talk but can walk the walk straight to victory in the general election against the Democrats. Unfortunately, we've seen our fair share of contenders who couldn't deliver when it mattered most. Dan Cox's past candidacy cost Maryland another Republican governor, and Neil Parrot? He's had not one, but two chances at this seat, and still couldn't seal the deal, even with the odds in his favor last year when the maps were re-drawn.
Let's call it like it is: these candidates have failed us, time and time again.
They've shown they can't resonate with the diverse electorate of our district, spanning both Frederick and Montgomery counties. And we simply cannot afford to take that risk again.
That's why I'm here, and why I need your unwavering support now more than ever. I'm Mariela Roca, and I'm not just another candidate—I'm the ONLY candidate with the proven track record, experience, education, unwavering dedication, and grassroots support to flip this district and secure a win for Republicans in November.
But let's not forget the bigger picture here: the future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th District if we want to keep control and continue advancing our conservative agenda.
That's where you come in. Your generous contributions have already propelled us forward, but we need to keep the momentum going. Every dollar you donate brings us one step closer to victory and ensures that our voices are heard in Washington.
Together, we can send a powerful message to the establishment and to the Democrats: Republicans are here to stay, and we're stronger than ever.
Thank you for your continued dedication and support. With your help, we will make history together.
Please donate today so we can get through the finish line and secure the Republican Nomination for MD-06 on May 14th! 🇺🇸
Warm regards,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=679234ab87&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=269a236bcc&e=0a12281e0e)
|
