# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=55d7cb3db1&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ed7b9fb4a0&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=37a009634f&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=724ea17053&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e7aa2fde94&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=43384e8ef5&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=3b14c12fd3&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f86fb44b84&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d127ef3000&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=37a39d84d0&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0a289aca69&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District

If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43925?refcode=em20240222-4890&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=4890%2E614464%2EDiqk_I)**

---
**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.
**[FIGHT BACK: ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43925?refcode=em20240222-4890&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=4890%2E614464%2EDiqk_I)**
Just as we saw in elections across the country — both this year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.

Representative Scholten is flailing. This week, Governor Whitmer’s administration asked Michiganders to ‘volunteer’ to house illegal migrants. | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=b010b36fe0&e=26f66c7cbd)

**Hudson: Rep. Scholten ‘Flailing’ on Immigration as Crisis Hits Michigan****–GOP Challenger Demands Accountability on Failed Immigration Policy–**
**Grand Rapids, MI** – “On the most pressing crisis of the day—securing our border—Representative Scholten is flailing. This week, Governor Whitmer’s administration asked Michiganders to ‘volunteer’ to house illegal migrants in their homes. [[1](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=df5212fc0d&e=26f66c7cbd)] Michigan residents are generous people, but a welcoming spirit should not be confused with serious immigration policy.
Having created a national crisis through an open-border policy, the government is now asking Michigan citizens to individually and personally shoulder the consequences. The border crisis has finally hit home, 2,000 miles away, with Hillary Scholten and the Biden administration to blame.
Rep. Scholten recently feigned frustration at Congress’ lack of action: ‘Unacceptable. We have an immigration crisis in our country that demands IMMEDIATE action. Speaker Johnson, we've had enough of the partisan games and delay. Put the bipartisan Dignity Act on the floor for a vote to help fix this crisis.’ [[2](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=9ef353408f&e=26f66c7cbd)]
“Scholten must think voters aren’t paying attention,” Hudson observed. “Does Hillary Scholten think voters are unaware that a year ago she voted against HR 2, the ‘Secure the Border Act,’ which the House of Representatives passed over her No vote? If she wanted ‘IMMEDIATE’ action, where was she a year ago?”
“If Congresswoman Scholten—who boasts about her expertise as an immigration attorney working at the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center [[3]](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=551025eae4&e=26f66c7cbd)—was actually serious about securing the border, she would have known within the first year of the Biden administration that this problem would soon become untenable and would not have voted against border security legislation last year before the crisis became an election issue. Her actions, inaction, and silence have contributed to the ongoing catastrophe, with nearly 10 million illegal crossings causing a national crisis. Now that the issue is on our front doorstep, Hillary Scholten has conveniently decided to end her silence.”
Hudson continued, “Congresswoman Scholten pretends to be bipartisan and complains about ‘partisan games and delay,’ but then turns around and votes party-line 96% of the time. [[4](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=e4d26a0022&e=26f66c7cbd)] West Michigan voters can see through the act. The truth is that when it came time to actually work with her colleagues across the aisle on significant border-security legislation, Hillary offered no serious amendments or solutions—just obstruction, political theater, and show-bills that have zero chance at becoming law.”
Hudson concluded that “Most complex problems have complex causes, but when it comes to the crisis at the border, this time it’s pretty simple: We have a border crisis because of the open-border philosophy of Hillary Scholten and the Biden administration. They own it, and now they’re putting the burden of their failures on the people of Michigan.”
Paul Hudson, a lifelong Michigander, is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state’s Third District. The [GOP primary election](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=19d4696ac8&e=26f66c7cbd) is Tuesday, August 6, 2024.# # # **Follow Paul Hudson:**[**Twitter**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=ced629e8da&e=26f66c7cbd)**|**[**Campaign Website**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=8d1738b2cc&e=26f66c7cbd)**|**[**Facebook**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=4d64ad5996&e=26f66c7cbd)

body:
Statement: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’ | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=fd415aca54&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
**Hudson: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’****—GOP Challenger Says Scholten & Colleagues Should ‘Stop Bickering, Start Budgeting’**
**Grand Rapids, MI** — “It’s a disservice to West Michigan that Representative Scholten and her colleagues went on vacation again right before yet another looming government shutdown,” observed Paul Hudson, the GOP candidate running against Scholten in Michigan’s Third Congressional District. Stopgap funding expires March 1 for agencies covered under spending bills for Energy, HUD, Transportation, VA and related agencies. A second deadline of March 8 applies to other agencies. [[1](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=7d30b10741&e=26f66c7cbd)] Congress has completed appropriations before the start of the fiscal year only four times in the last four decades. The last time Congress completed all bills on time was 20 years ago, in 1996. [[2](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=daaaaefe3c&e=26f66c7cbd)} “This is no way to run a government. If Hillary is wondering why Congress has a 15% approval rating, this is why,” observed Hudson, a West Michigan resident. [[3](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=dad11fe8b2&e=26f66c7cbd)] “There’s plenty of blame to go around, on both sides of the aisle. Nobody cares. Just get back to work until the job is done.”
“Members don’t need or deserve a holiday given their history of fiscal mismanagement. Congresswoman Scholten should go back to Washington, stop the bickering and start budgeting. Enough kicking the can down the road. Job #1 in Congress is passing a federal budget – which means prioritizing national spending – and Hillary and her colleagues have failed miserably at this most basic responsibility.”
The House plans to return on February 28. The Senate plans to return from its recess February 26.
While Congress can act within a matter of days to pass temporary spending, that short time frame raises the odds that the agencies affected by the first deadline will face a partial shutdown of at least several days. [[4](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=ec604eeaed&e=26f66c7cbd)] The Republican challenger said that “from now until election day, I will continue to put forward specific measures to bring ‘budget sanity’ to Congress—it’s the bare minimum West Michigan residents deserve in their next representative.” A lifelong Michigander, Paul Hudson is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state’s Third district. The [GOP primary election](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=7ed3deae57&e=26f66c7cbd) for United States House of Representatives is Tuesday, August 6, 2024.

clean_body: Statement: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’ | | | | | Hudson: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’—GOP Challenger Says Scholten & Colleagues Should ‘Stop Bickering, Start Budgeting’ Grand Rapids, MI — “It’s a disservice to West Michigan that Representative Scholten and her colleagues went on vacation again right before yet another looming government shutdown,” observed Paul Hudson, the GOP candidate running against Scholten in Michigan’s Third Congressional District. Stopgap funding expires March 1 for agencies covered under spending bills for Energy, HUD, Transportation, VA and related agencies. A second deadline of March 8 applies to other agencies. ] Congress has completed appropriations before the start of the fiscal year only four times in the last four decades. The last time Congress completed all bills on time was 20 years ago, in 1996. } “This is no way to run a government. If Hillary is wondering why Congress has a 15% approval rating, this is why,” observed Hudson, a West Michigan resident. ] “There’s plenty of blame to go around, on both sides of the aisle. Nobody cares. Just get back to work until the job is done.” “Members don’t need or deserve a holiday given their history of fiscal mismanagement. Congresswoman Scholten should go back to Washington, stop the bickering and start budgeting. Enough kicking the can down the road. Job #1 in Congress is passing a federal budget – which means prioritizing national spending – and Hillary and her colleagues have failed miserably at this most basic responsibility.” The House plans to return on February 28. The Senate plans to return from its recess February 26. While Congress can act within a matter of days to pass temporary spending, that short time frame raises the odds that the agencies affected by the first deadline will face a partial shutdown of at least several days. ] The Republican challenger said that “from now until election day, I will continue to put forward specific measures to bring ‘budget sanity’ to Congress—it’s the bare minimum West Michigan residents deserve in their next representative.” A lifelong Michigander, Paul Hudson is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state’s Third district. clean_body: Friends, Trust me, I understand your frustrations with Washington. I was ready to take a break, spend time with family, and perhaps grab a beer and just sit with my husband at our farm instead of spending tireless hours every day standing up to the corrupt politicians trying to rob us of our freedoms. After a barrage of phone calls, personal meetings, and grocery store conversations with constituents encouraging me to stay in the fight, I knew I had to listen. I needed to give the people of Indiana's 5th District the opportunity to choose a freedom fighter to represent them in Congress. I will be honest with you, our Republic is in trouble. If we want our children to experience any semblance of an American dream, we need more people in office who will fight for them and conservative policies. Representing you in Congress is an honor I do not take lightly. I could not abandon you to people more interested in personal agendas than individual liberties. As always, I will keep fighting for the conservative values that we need, the conservative values that made America the greatest country in the world. subject: The scheme to eviscerate Medicare
body:
Will you stand with me?

| |
---
| | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z89lsba20kp7amivacjaj6tocpliqka7fb6fqago_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdj6aor4c5h2bs)

---
Dear Fellow American,The radicals pictured above have been doing everything in their power to ensure that undocumented immigrants get the same healthcare you get...while you foot the bill!That’s NOT FAIR to law-abiding Americans like you who worked for decades to fund Medicare.Former President Trump was 100% right when he said this scheme would “** _eviscerate Medicare_** ” which millions of Senior Citizens rely on.But still, Joe Biden, the “Squad,” and all the other radical House Democrats want “Medicare for All” legislation.> Legislation that would give the hundreds of thousands of illegals pouring over our border the same Medicare benefits you have. > Legislation that will collapse our entire healthcare system in no time at all.The radicals keep pushing for this disastrous scheme and we must keep fighting to stop them. **[**Will you stand with me?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcpq278h4mnnh3q2efehdri37ctgcn3rl23j8ra0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdj6aor4c5h2bs)** My name is Bob Carlstrom. I’m the President of AMAC Action. AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.**We’ve got 82 chapters and 348 volunteer delegates, who are “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with****elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC****members to meet, hear, and question them.** **And you should also know that we now have more than 358,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with Members of the U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. We’re committed to stopping AOC, Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, Pramila Jayapal, Ayanna Pressley and the rest of their “Squad” from doing untold damage to you and your health care.And more “Medicare recipients” means more trouble getting an appointment with your preferred doctor and less access to the treatments and medication you need. At the end of the day, “Medicare for All” would be the reason that the entire healthcare system in the United States collapses and becomes insolvent......thus requiring a complete government takeover.And make no mistake, complete government takeover of healthcare is EXACTLY what AOC and her “Squad” want. It’s their path to enacting socialism in the United States of America.We’re leading a grassroots effort to make sure this threat to Seniors’ healthcare – and to our country – is stopped dead in its tracks before it’s too late.If you want to stop this threat, AMAC Action is your partner in the fight. **[And today, I need your help to stop the radical Left that’s marching us towards a Socialist America.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdd4t2tpvnnc8jndgi4u7vi845qvsg23nk1vr33g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdj6aor4c5h2bs)** President Trump understood that AND he knew the threat radical Leftists posed to your health care. That’s why when we met with him, he encouraged us to:
---
| | **Grow our AMAC membership ...Stand up to the liberal AARP... And help stop the Left’s radical agenda!** **[**Today, you can personally help answer that call with an emergency, one-time contribution of $35.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk11s4f289dbpfjkfsasrole3dmgsnq8pbn9n7no_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sdj6aor4c5h2bs)** Of course, if you are able to give more than $35, say $50, $75, $125, $500, or even $1,000... it’d be a huge help.
---
|
---
| | But whether you can give $35 or $1,000, please act now! I think I speak for millions of Seniors whose health care is being threatened by this cabal of _Medicare for Illegals_ radicals when I say, thank you for standing with us in this fight!
---
| | Sincerely,
---
Bob Carlstrom, PresidentAMAC Action

name: Michelle Steel [CA-45]
subject: My life in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michelle Steel for Congress
body:
I know this message is longer than usual, but it would mean the world if you could take a second to read it.

| |
---
| | | Hi Friend, it’s Michelle Steel. I wanted to take a moment to tell you my full story. This message is longer than usual, but I hope that you will read every word.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

_I'm a wife, mother, immigrant, and an advocate for American families and businesses._

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

My parents escaped from North Korea in hopes of giving our family a better life. I owe so much to my parents. Despite losing everything to communism, they never gave up. Their courage, bravery, and resilience taught me so much, and I am so grateful for their sacrifices.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

I moved to America as a teenager. My family and I started a small business from the ground up. I watched my mother struggle with tedious government processes,**I realized that the government is failing the people who need it most. **

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

I knew then that I wanted to do more to help, so I ran for the California State Board of Equalization and then, the Orange County Board of Supervisors. I was the highest-ranking Korean-American elected official in the country.

**I gave almost $400 million back to California taxpayers, and that put a major target on my back.**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

I decided that I wanted to take my fight to Washington, so I ran for Congress in a Democrat-held seat. I defied all odds and by the skin of my teeth, I won. My race was one of the most hard-fought in the country. Last year was more of the same, but we won again and helped take back the House Majority.

I'll be blunt, Friend, without your support, my campaign is in major trouble. _**[I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can’t fight back without your support.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30608%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KU838ItHWYlC95BMaVJVPg&sysid=1 "I am in the fight of my
life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can’t fight back without your support.")**_

The White House, House Democrats, and several far-Left have all named me a TOP target. Biden even came to California twice to personally raise money against California Republicans like me.

I am personally asking for just $10 to keep my fight alive. _**[Will you stand with me?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30609%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I%2biHsJSjRbz2pHcCkQdqPg&sysid=1 "Will you stand with
me?")**_

---
| | [STAND WITH MICHELLE](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30600%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6XmPw6nkpSsOvL1KxA%2bF1w&sysid=1 "TEST TEST TEST")
---

Thank you for your time and consideration,

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EkYSnmhrDh19U7pZ7E7MKA&sysid=1)
---

Michelle Steel (CA-45)

P.S. I know that times are tough for so many Americans. _**I**_ f you can’t afford to give right now, __**[it would mean a lot if you would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30601%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AIn1I5xPl%2fb%2bNuBNeSBgQw&sysid=1 "it would mean a lot if you
would officially join my team by submitting your endorsement.")**__

---

---

I am 1 of 18 House Republicans being targeted by Biden’s White House and I have an exclusive memo I need you to see.

Extreme Florida lawmakers would rather cozy up to the gun lobby than keep students and teachers safe from gun violence.
#

We hate to share bad news, but we need to update you on what’s going on in Florida:
Last month, a Florida House committee voted to repeal part of the Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School Public Safety Act. This would allow teenagers to buy rifles like the one used in the Parkland shooting, erasing bipartisan progress made in the aftermath.
Just last week, we marked six years since the tragedy in Parkland. Even though seventeen people lost their lives in this shooting, Florida lawmakers are actively trying to dismantle key legislation that was put in place in the aftermath of this tragedy.
Extreme Florida lawmakers would rather cozy up to the gun lobby than keep students and teachers safe from gun violence. It’s unacceptable, and we need to fight back.

subject: A personal note
body:
I convinced the team to let me send this

| Hi friend,
Even though you don't know who I am, I convinced the email team here at Evergreen to let me send a personal note to you all so that I can share my gratitude.

I hope you already know that your engagement with our work is crucial to our outward mission—**but you probably don't know how much your support matters _inside_ of this organization.**

As the chief of staff for our 30-person team, I oversee the internal workings at Evergreen. From building culture and supporting professional development, to establishing sector-leading benefits and leading strategic planning, I ensure that Evergreen staff have what they need to ceaselessly work for bold climate action.

In 2023, I had the pleasure of being busy doing what I love. We added 12 new members to the Evergreen team—that's new, dedicated expertise on climate policy, campaigns, state action, communications, digital, and operations.

And I'll share with you that this team is not just incredibly smart, hard-working, and so good at what they do—they're also full of heart. **They care deeply about each other, their communities, and the future we're building.** (They didn't make me say that, but they did bold that sentence!)

Even though we've grown, we remain a small and mighty team, and your engagement—whether you take action to make an impact, donate to sustain our work, or learn something you can share—is what makes us effective.

**Thanks to your support, I'm better able to do my job: empowering our dedicated team.**

So, thank you. |
---
[HELP SUSTAIN OUR WORK NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2353276/87SdQ4wZ)

---
| Working together, we're building a thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future.

Thank you again for being here with us, |

---
### Rufino Velazquez
Chief of Staff

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
We should expect more from our representatives than simply checking a box by changing their address

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1934%2E4032634%2EHAzTVT)
---
Call me radical, but if you’re running to represent the people of Massachusetts, you should probably be someone who didn't just relocate to Massachusetts days before filing for office. In case you missed it, a Republican named John Deaton just announced he is running against me for Senate. The thing is, he only officially changed his mailing address to a rental home in Massachusetts a few weeks earlier — and just put his Rhode Island mansion on the market. Two months ago, he tweeted this out to his followers: “Is there time for me to buy a home in Massachusetts, actually move there, and run for Senate?” Maybe so, John. But we should expect more from our representatives in Washington than simply checking a box by changing their address. We can’t expect someone to swoop in from out of state and get the job done — but we also can’t underestimate this threat. [**I’m not taking anything for granted, because I know that the GOP and wealthy special interests will fund my opponent’s campaign. The way we stay competitive and win is through grassroots donations. So can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to protect our Senate majority — and make sure the Bay State is represented by a Bay Stater?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1897?amount=28&t=8&akid=1934%2E4032634%2EHAzTVT)

The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction. If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, Winning this election requires a one-two punch: 1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day. In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That's my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. With you on our side, I'm confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again. | | With deepest appreciation, Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | MY VISION My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference. In baseball, it's not about the individual; it's about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. My campaign is different. I'm running for Senate because I believe that public service is about truly fighting for and listening to the families you swear to serve. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79518375/456700683/2045957508?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDUzZWE5N2QtYWJkMS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xEGG5Qv2QQTb3vY1OkOftk3oMzxcyorEiVWDLKwKWkg=&emci=11037023-cdd0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=053ea97d-abd1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=10481059)
---

| | Peter — Every year, I always prioritize getting to one place: Camp Harmony. This year was no different. While I had to step away from the fun in the afternoons to canvas and doorknock — I was able to spend time in the mornings and evenings at the place that first inspired me to delve deeper into public service. **Camp Harmony is a non-profit, sleepaway camp hosting approximately 300 campers from underserved areas in and around Los Angeles County.** Campers arrive by bus to meet their new specially chosen counselors and the fun begins: upwards of 30 different activities a day keep children engaged, excited, enriched, and active. Camp Harmony's work is incredible:
* We bring together kids from 12+ shelters, agencies and schools;
* Over 600 under-served children attend camp annually;
* 350 counselors and 200 adult support staff volunteer annually;
* 1,500 sweatshirts and t-shirts, 600 new sleeping bags are distributed to campers annually;
* And 3 hot meals are served daily.

_A snap from last summer at Camp Harmony!_ During my time volunteering with Camp Harmony, I've seen year after year what a difference summer camp can make for kids. They build new relationships, not just with each other, but with mentors and role models in the form of counselors. And at camp, these kids will connect with, and come to love, the planet that we're asking them to help save. **These opportunities make such a difference for children and their families, and I know that we could be doing more, Peter.** Every day, countless young individuals in our city are facing the harsh reality of housing instability. These kids, often vulnerable and lacking adequate support systems, find themselves without stable housing, facing uncertainty and instability in their daily lives. **The effects of housing insecurity can last a lifetime.** So together, let's do more. We can make bigger investments in preventing housing insecurity for kids, to create inclusive and compassionate communities where every young person has the opportunity to thrive. I am determined to do more because this isn't a new fight for me — our kids should always come first. They build new relationships, not just with each other, but with mentors and role models in the form of counselors. And at camp, these kids will connect with, and come to love, the planet that we're asking them to help save. These opportunities make such a difference for children and their families, and I know that we could be doing more, Peter. Every day, countless young individuals in our city are facing the harsh reality of housing instability. These kids, often vulnerable and lacking adequate support systems, find themselves without stable housing, facing uncertainty and instability in their daily lives. The effects of housing insecurity can last a lifetime. So together, let's do more. We can make bigger investments in preventing housing insecurity for kids, to create inclusive and compassionate communities where every young person has the opportunity to thrive. I am determined to do more because this isn't a new fight for me — our kids should always come first. More soon, Nick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Nick Melvoin for Congress - FEC ID #C00831289 |

Peter,

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again – it's **ridiculous** and **asinine** that we’re even having to talk about biological men competing in women’s sports. Yet here we are today thanks to woke-left insanity.

In recent years, transgender “women” have won dozens of women’s sports championships. Young women are being robbed of educational opportunities that sports provide.

_And we’ve all seen the stories about young women who’ve been badly hurt while competing against biological males who have an undeniable physical advantage over them._

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Trump’s tax cuts for corporations and the wealthy increased our national debt by $2 trillion [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2024/01/12/trump-tax-cuts-2024/] ; they made the rich richer while hurting working and middle-class Americans.

A second Trump presidency would make it worse. He has promised [https://www.vanityfair.com/news/2023/09/donald-trump-second-term-tax-cuts] to slash taxes for the super-rich and proposed a 10% tariff [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/01/22/trumps-proposed-10percent-tariff-plan-would-shake-up-every-asset-class-strategist.html] on all foreign-made goods, costing each American household about $2,000 [https://www.economist.com/leaders/2023/11/02/donald-trumps-tariff-plans-would-inflict-grievous-damage-on-america-and-the-world] annually.

Sign if you agree: A second Trump presidency would hurt working and middle-class Americans [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-trump-would-mean-more-tax-cuts-for-the-wealthy-3/?source=20240130SWNoTrumpTaxCuts_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dk-trump-tax-cuts-petition-swap] .

Sign the Petition [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-trump-would-mean-more-tax-cuts-for-the-wealthy-3/?source=20240130SWNoTrumpTaxCuts_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdk-trump-tax-cuts-petition-swap]

Trump did nothing to help America’s working families during his presidency. 1,800 factories shuttered between 2016 and 2018. Trump lied to supporters [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/he-lied-ohio-voters-struggle-after-trump-promised-jobs] , saying that jobs would come back and left them in the cold. If allowed to return to the White House, we can expect the gap between the wealthy and everyone else to grow.

For working Americans to prosper, we must end tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy and embrace a vision of new economic patriotism. That means bringing unionized, well-paying manufacturing jobs back to the United States to communities left behind by globalization. It means incentivizing factory construction, investing in training opportunities and manufacturing process innovations, and pushing the federal government to use tax revenues to purchase items made in America. It means restoring our country to a manufacturing superpower, one that meets the needs of the 21st century.

Sign the petition: Reject Trump’s tax cuts for the wealthy and make a moonshot investment in the American industry. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-trump-would-mean-more-tax-cuts-for-the-wealthy-3/?source=20240130SWNoTrumpTaxCuts_RK&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dk-trump-tax-cuts-petition-swap]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

clean_body: | ~ Peter, I’ve gotten a lot of pushback since I first announced I was running for Congress. People said I was too young. That I didn’t look or act like a Congressman. That my legislative priorities were too pie-in-the-sky. But there’s one subject Republicans can’t get enough of attacking me for: not being rich. What they don’t realize is that their favorite attack line is actually something we need more of. We need and deserve young, working, everyday people in Congress who know firsthand the struggles of the working class – and I’m proud to represent us. But increasing our ranks means building an unbeatable organizing movement, and to do that, I need as much grassroots support as I can get. I need you , Peter. ~ | ~ I’ll never apologize for having humble beginnings – because my family fought to give me what chances I’ve had. My abuela, mom, and aunt fled Cuba in the 1960s with no money, and without knowing English. My abuela worked multiple factory jobs just to give her kids a better shot. It’s her legacy I’m carrying forward when I walk onto the House floor, Peter. Because working people know – we’re in this together. But let’s be real: You shouldn’t have to be working class to care about working class priorities. You don’t need to be rejected by an apartment, or become houseless, or drive Uber to make ends meet – all of which I’ve done – to know that our economy isn’t working for everybody. You just have to care. ~ | | ~ ~ | ~ | ~~ In this together, Maxwell Frost ~~ ~ | PAID FOR BY MAXWELL FROST FOR CONGRESS Maxwell Frost for Congress PO Box 772671 Orlando, FL 32877-2671 United States | Maxwell is an organizer representing Florida's 10th Congressional District in Congress. name: David Hogg
subject: The NRA’s tax returns aren’t pretty
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Mark my words, friend : Gen Z will outlive the NRA.
The Daily Beast recently analyzed the NRA’s tax returns. They aren’t pretty.
In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members.
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America.
I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.
With so much riding on the upcoming elections, we’re preparing now so we can elect the leaders we deserve in November. Will you split a contribution to support Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations.
Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected our very first candidate.
In the days leading up to the November election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for Nadarius Clark. Thanks to our supporters’ donations, we were proud to invest more than $100,000 to support Nadarius’s campaign.
When all the ballots were counted, Nadarius won by less than 2,000 votes.
Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning these fights in 2024. There is too much on the line for us to lose.
Leaders We Deserve and Serve America can only be successful in November with your continued support, so can you split a contribution or whatever makes sense for you today? Anything you can give will make a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thank you for your consideration,
David Hogg
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

Subject: Not tomorrow, not five years from now. Right Now.
Date: Tuesday, Feb 20, 2024

Team—The climate crisis is here, and its impact on people in the Lower Hudson Valley is already severe.

Last year was officially the hottest year on record, and New York suffered the worst air quality since the 1960s after being engulfed in smoke from the raging wildfires in Canada.

Across the nation, one in four Americans breathe air considered unhealthy as a _direct_ result of the climate crisis. We’ve seen a five-fold increase since 2000 in the number of days unsafe for our children to play outside.

**Congress has a moral obligation to meet this moment and act now.** But, for decades, Republicans—backed by billions in lobbying from the fossil fuel industry—denied the climate crisis, calling it a hoax. In fact, many Republicans, including Mike Lawler, still do. Not surprising for someone who was an oil and gas lobbyist.

[**We cannot bury our heads in the sand any longer. Unless we act now, the consequences of the climate crisis will be irreversible. Add your name to join me in calling on Congress to meet this moment and prioritize urgent climate action—not in five years, not tomorrow—NOW.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79524988/456716431/-1946074301?ms=em24_240222_clim2_fndd_gq_act___TM_ettx&refcode=em24_240222_clim2_fndd_gq_act___TM_ettx&source=em24_240222_clim2_fndd_gq_act___TM_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240222_clim2_fndd_gq_act___TM_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=3D+dlwWaw2x31BJQb/guyimm4KTUdzeQ7nMaUvzZs0wYRzsvrxAKdqaeT5GnpMy8fHGnL2DC/wMlbQ/XVxL/+VTPWbddrMlB/M/xCm91qis=&refcode2=73d11894-b4d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2QxMTg5NC1iNGQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=maiaQZJsqqHE52YIWXv34ty2ryiqOR_-EKFVL0od-6U=&emci=5b5a8a5a-9ad1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=73d11894-b4d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24719896)

Helping everyone build a path toward homeownership and financial independence is one of my top priorities, and I'm ready to bring this work to Congress. [If this is important to you as well, please sign up to volunteer with my campaign and help us reach voters with my agenda to strengthen our communities.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79526351/456720965/-104131788?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240222_1_2&refcode2=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&contactdata=LlDD88wElL2EFK9CSce5Lz38vnMPecaDjd/xuLWG8Hh/KimqG/d2q2n51rQ/2rOY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTRkYTRmOC1iNWQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lSt1ege7DrBGw7oxWh8tya6UlXDN6G864A6T9WxS5m4=&emci=7dd51a4f-afd1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24669367)

* * *
EVERYONE in our communities should have a viable path to family financial independence and homeownership! **EVERYONE!**

During our many Listening Sessions and at folk’s doors across PA-10, we frequently hear that “affordable” or “public” housing is just not good enough. I agree. EVERYONE in America should have the opportunity to live in the safety and generational wealth-building power of a home they own.

As your Congressperson, I will work tirelessly to help make it so. Scott Perry fails to do so. Last week, the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) announced nearly $130 million to Empower HUD-Assisted Families Towards Financial Stability and Savings. In addition to funding programs to support economic independence for vulnerable communities, these grants provide renewed federal funding for Public Housing Agencies in Cumberland, Dauphin, and York Counties. This funding will make a tangible difference in our communities.

However, If Scott Perry and his “Freedom Caucus” had their way with the 2024 Federal Budget, little to none of that federal funding would have arrived here in PA-10. Scott Perry does not care about us.

[If you agree that facilitating a path to family financial independence and homeownership should be top priorities for our elected representatives, add your name here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79526352/456720966/-1930217902?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240222_1_2&refcode2=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&contactdata=LlDD88wElL2EFK9CSce5Lz38vnMPecaDjd/xuLWG8Hh/KimqG/d2q2n51rQ/2rOY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTRkYTRmOC1iNWQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lSt1ege7DrBGw7oxWh8tya6UlXDN6G864A6T9WxS5m4=&emci=7dd51a4f-afd1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24669367) | | **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79526353/456720967/-1930217902?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240222_1_2&refcode2=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&contactdata=LlDD88wElL2EFK9CSce5Lz38vnMPecaDjd/xuLWG8Hh/KimqG/d2q2n51rQ/2rOY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTRkYTRmOC1iNWQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lSt1ege7DrBGw7oxWh8tya6UlXDN6G864A6T9WxS5m4=&emci=7dd51a4f-afd1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=de4da4f8-b5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24669367)**

I will always support and empower historically disadvantaged communities, including helping implement the “7-point plan to increase Black homeownership by 3 million households by 2030” articulated by the Black Homeownership Collaborative:
1. Homeownership Counseling
2. Down Payment Assistance
3. Housing Production
4. Credit and Lending
5. Civil and Consumer Rights
6. Homeownership Sustainability
7. Marketing and Outreach

[In short: PA-10 deserves a representative who will prioritize family financial independence and homeownership for _ALL_. Friend, This week, the Biden administration vetoed another UN ceasefire resolution. Once again, the U.S. was the only country to block the resolution—going against the will of the American people, and against the will of 153 UN member countries that invoked ceasefire measures. **This genocide of Palestinians is only possible because of U.S. weapons and political support.** Instead of listening to the American people, my colleagues in the U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill last week to criminalize our constitutional free speech right to engage in political boycotts. Boycotting is a historical part of U.S. movements for freedom. To silence criticism of Israel, lawmakers in 37 states have passed anti-boycott laws. Robert's life epitomized what it meant to get into good trouble, and his example inspires me every day. I'm going to tell you more about his story and after, I hope you'll feel inspired to [_**chip in a few bucks to help me win my battleground race here in South Carolina.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79528360/456727108/761589530?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.02.22_B1_RobertSmallsBio_30op-Expansion&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ1ODUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWJiZWE2NTgtYmFkMS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yDlSacw4JazJL7ePD2aN3CuWt9l5nK8SjSh4ujlO0x4=) Robert was born a slave and was conscripted into the Confederacy to be a ship pilot during the Civil War. Because of his skills, he acquired the trust of the Confederate captains aboard his ship, the _Planter._ On an evening when the Confederate captains left the ship, Robert used his self-taught skills as a pilot to steer himself, and his Black crewmates and their families to safety in the North. The families that Robert steered to safety were given safe harbor, and the ship was gifted to the Union – helping build their naval fleet and win the war. Robert later came back to South Carolina and served as Congressman for Beaufort, dedicated to fighting injustice everywhere. My great-great-grandfather had the audacity to risk everything he had, never tire, and lead a life of service. **I'm running against Nancy Mace in my battleground district of SC-01 because Robert Smalls' fight isn't over, and I know South Carolina's best days are still ahead of us.** Early support is crucial to the success of our campaign. With our end-of-month fundraising goal hurdling our way, we must generate as much grassroots momentum as possible. [_**I'm running for Congress to fight for families across the Lowcountry and continue the legacy of service instilled in me by my great-great-grandfather. | [H.B. 149](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yYyupbHK9bWZVd3aH0pFXKP31PDycaQjqqEjnpCOKvMixdvP41JorzcsM7RmzPjEWI652c00leevSjjLHpUoqe-V9x2YLTW6FuhLreTkkuMZyfa0BSUGERG0qQ_nqsL07d_pTeRk9OrMUqeKZrLUPqI=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) Patron: Helmer Employee protections; medicinal use of cannabis product. Amends the provision that prohibits an employer from discriminating against an employee for such employee's lawful use of cannabis product pursuant to a valid written certification issued by a practitioner for the treatment or to eliminate the symptoms of the employee's diagnosed condition or disease, with certain exceptions, by specifying that such use must conform to the laws of the Commonwealth and that such protections extend to the employees of the Commonwealth and other public bodies. A BILL to amend and reenact § [40.1-27.4](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yYyupbHK9bWZ_IJ6XEafM4eaaHRd3s-inTGXmb9nNNSim1r45tpHt2etK6pO14zlrXxdgoZMh6-Oa5k--bpJzNl3AY4n3b2u1jChH5qlGnPxZ144Drv13L4=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to employee protections; medicinal use of cannabis product.24100935D
[H.B. 457](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yWZ54nrCxl815-rRvZMvG0VVoqerJ8usAvpIlWaY5-BT8gCqeLMdF5GpGqLq6N4Xbdvym4H_4ArdzCxmRP3offN8rGiNFEWAYr_CVrn0hQgEU79V0iHlrgtE81eyogXrkn1Gp3XKMr3EI5jIJdaqyGI=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) Patron: Callsen Decreasing probation period; criteria for mandatory reduction. Establishes criteria for which a defendant's supervised probation period shall be reduced, including completing qualifying educational activities, maintaining verifiable employment, and complying with or completing any state-certified or state-approved state-certified or state-approved mental health or substance abuse treatment program. The bill also provides that a court may decrease a defendant's probation period if warranted by the defendant's conduct and in the interests of justice and may do so without a hearing. A BILL to amend and reenact § [19.2-304](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yWZ54nrCxl81vvrlEkfalqw_xJ8aD3SgiH_fF7e4z7odz7FbjYqWgCn76xecliF2PwyCwSSOeSt7vxRWQvB7kuK4hUXMhTYEvXlA7LTJIfdMq63HNFqTph4=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to decreasing probation period; criteria for mandatory reduction.24106826D
[H.B. 698](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yWZ54nrCxl81pFkIa-3y7rGi_VvBelXSPjRdyxqMQoXEMbBcY-chV-XGZDNr8bGiqK1blwvBGoo_oqjh7fgWfMV-D-XDOaofYw-1TAlz8QslKNCSyhW0eJOBs4vMI1iee7rkeqv666Gm8wLTv8N6H2U=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) Patron: Krizek Cannabis control; retail market; penalties. Establishes a framework for the creation of a retail marijuana market in the Commonwealth, to be administered by the Virginia Cannabis Control Authority (the Authority). The bill allows the Authority to begin issuing all marijuana licenses on July 1, 2025; however, the bill (i) allows certain micro business to begin operations, other than retail sales, on July 1, 2024, or the date on which the Board of Directors of the Authority (the Board) provides notice to the Division of Legislative Services (the Division) that it is prepared to provide oversight of such operations, whichever is later, and (ii) allows pharmaceutical processors, certain micro businesses, and five industrial hemp processors to fully operate, including engaging in retail sales, on January 1, 2025, or the date on which the Board provides notice to the Division that it is prepared to provide oversight of such operations and sales, whichever is later.
[H.B. 815](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yWZ54nrCxl81tGtPC6C_wzor3KBhnH--civuJnS27ZBoIlPmuAjlh4VilzMCVYZMsbBYtEZDg8FjAgIgKvuUsHrxHWO_EFJmH-z3BdGdvegdKOe-d7lOgtspUf4j4LJI8SGCVlSRgLVbDrWz0Ta_jZo=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) Patron: Cherry Medical cannabis program; product expiration; confidentiality; penalty. Increases from six months to 12 months the maximum expiration date allowable for a cannabis product after registration absent stability testing. The bill allows pharmaceutical processors to employ as pharmacy technician trainees individuals who have less than one year of experience and allows pharmaceutical processors to employ persons with less than one year of experience to perform certain other supervised duties for which current law requires two years of experience. The bill also provides for the confidentiality of certain records and other information of the Board of Directors of the Virginia Cannabis Control Authority, including the exemption of certain information from the mandatory disclosure provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act.

| [H.B. 888](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bZ5e1eDk0O6O42jpnsALNUFS1Nu90y5l0r3XTCk645Z1JWK64XB1yWZ54nrCxl816aKcgjEUbvs4ZeVh5mxBFj6AruDHFgAnUxNuBL2pKhCUPHxqHlj7JKiIp4ek0w0M2OB5ufM0zhTSWQu8_-izkA3JRfvDxe-Dz_oPX16bTkF8Uauw3DQSPpq3SiGNU7UJUsMnxzMtQxY=&c=4vGM2cWqlxOGizDBMRW9wgX-ATG5AtqLd3G7X6rcaTK6AJUf6dgHUg==&ch=zlwrhKFh0d8tNNVuMhriXOsUe10V6XcOnG9Kqix6HQiX2O4ft4E80g==) Patron: Watts
Civil commitments and temporary detention orders; definition of mental illness; neurocognitive disorders and neurodevelopmental disabilities; Secretary of Health and Human Resources to evaluate placements for certain individuals; report. Specifies that for the purpose of civil commitments and temporary detention orders, behaviors and symptoms that manifest from a neurocognitive disorder or neurodevelopmental disability are excluded from the definition of mental illness and are, therefore, not a basis for placing an individual under a temporary detention order or committing an individual involuntarily to an inpatient psychiatric hospital. The bill provides that if a state facility has reason to believe that an individual's behaviors or symptoms are solely a manifestation of a neurocognitive disorder or neurodevelopmental disability, the state facility may require that a licensed psychiatrist or other licensed mental health professional reevaluate the individual's eligibility for a temporary detention order before the individual is admitted and shall promptly authorize the release of an individual held under a temporary detention order if the licensed psychiatrist or other licensed mental health professional determines the individual's behaviors or symptoms are solely a manifestation of a neurocognitive disorder or neurodevelopmental disability. The foregoing provisions of the bill do not become effective unless reenacted by the 2025 Session of the General Assembly. The bill also directs the Secretary of Health and Human Resources to convene a work group to evaluate, identify, and develop placements for individuals with neurocognitive disorders and neurodevelopmental disabilities, as well as any statutory or funding changes needed to prevent inappropriate placements for such individuals, and to report his findings and recommendations by November 1, 2024. This bill is a recommendation of the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission and the Behavioral Health Commission.

Peter, picture this: a state database tracking every person who's dared to make a choice about their body, complete with a "patient identifier."
Next month, the OK House will vote to make this horrible nightmare our reality. Oklahoma already has a total ban on abortions — doctors will be convicted of murder if they try to help a woman who is dying. By mandating invasive tracking of women's health decisions, this bill not only violates personal freedoms but also sets a chilling precedent for privacy rights.
If we’re going to restore women’s rights in Oklahoma, it has to be at the federal level - Stitt has 4 more years and Stephanie Bice is doubling down on her full support for these cruel, extreme laws.
That’s why it’s so vital we seize this moment in the district right now; we may not have another chance .

| | | Hi Friend, it's Michelle Steel. I wanted to take a moment to tell you my full story. This message is longer than usual, but I hope that you will read every word.

_I'm a wife, mother, immigrant, and an advocate for American families and businesses._

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=31e873e4cc484f5dbd91c701e315c76d&_e=d1DmxAEUJlloI9MKUQm05u950rynO3-1KSdGyWzsEAWvHDHdKA08dwkC2iVy0dSfj606XUHR-VuRvSJOepCRRo5_uwS0ILxpoFnIadmNYVor8AHB1R_-F4tygrDujTuolIMchBROsstoBeDCecBxAVBM2MdsXns-d1kRknX2q8Wqbjch1AnNFe1LUZ6OoxA964dACCkzsedj5FYVoyR1u6XdNiz6MQiMg4Q0yExIOHbbbuN6Sp8cuvzL6cA28wYkZp2fxJaaXgkD_c-h3938QCwPo_y7bl3DFZN6ZcMDhWO3a4i5zPAtej-KLSe1eMMNxLjoXbtONfwnPYcvXF8GkixXv3GeIeANiTIAGd5QNrUk-YAWmjJ9zRKG43wxMoDbIv61KW7ln8d5pLWSNCYQUVY14LaLzZo7wwvEHMR23QVl7awcsq-zeFIvCz9SDUiEnrNI5OiHFC0PMD-yF0zKllw6qAXbq4mt-ICp61nks5U%3D)

My parents escaped from North Korea in hopes of giving our family a better life. I owe so much to my parents. Despite losing everything to communism, they never gave up. Their courage, bravery, and resilience taught me so much, and I am so grateful for their sacrifices.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=31e873e4cc484f5dbd91c701e315c76d&_e=d1DmxAEUJlloI9MKUQm05u950rynO3-1KSdGyWzsEAWvHDHdKA08dwkC2iVy0dSfj606XUHR-VuRvSJOepCRRo5_uwS0ILxpoFnIadmNYVor8AHB1R_-F4tygrDujTuolIMchBROsstoBeDCecBxAVBM2MdsXns-d1kRknX2q8Wqbjch1AnNFe1LUZ6OoxA964dACCkzsedj5FYVoyR1u6XdNiz6MQiMg4Q0yExIOHbbbuN6Sp8cuvzL6cA28wYkZp2fxJaaXgkD_c-h3938QCwPo_y7bl3DFZN6ZcMDhWO3a4i5zPAtej-KLSe1eMMNxLjoXbtONfwnPYcvXF8GkuLa1u-QDQ6G4NBnm9a3fF6-pQ3MDmHfL4uc3b3QAYoDtEsunvGg25BVxXIwSLtIlLeCNXeBJlicPORVV01gVSoKP15bTyNaw1wuHoIo_E_iCaRmQYf1UhU8E_EvIrCEdWHCzq5-f7gY2MBf3Sz8V1Y%3D)
---

I moved to America as a teenager. My family and I started a small business from the ground up. I watched my mother struggle with tedious government processes,**I realized that the government is failing the people who need it most. **

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=31e873e4cc484f5dbd91c701e315c76d&_e=d1DmxAEUJlloI9MKUQm05u950rynO3-1KSdGyWzsEAWvHDHdKA08dwkC2iVy0dSfj606XUHR-VuRvSJOepCRRo5_uwS0ILxpoFnIadmNYVor8AHB1R_-F4tygrDujTuolIMchBROsstoBeDCecBxAVBM2MdsXns-d1kRknX2q8Wqbjch1AnNFe1LUZ6OoxA964dACCkzsedj5FYVoyR1u6XdNiz6MQiMg4Q0yExIOHbbbuN6Sp8cuvzL6cA28wYkZp2fxJaaXgkD_c-h3938QCwPo_y7bl3DFZN6ZcMDhWO3a4i5zPAtej-KLSe1eMMNxLjoXbtONfwnPYcvXF8GkmdXhIHlAHkiQNds-qMSXtItSz_Crw9TGlp1zo43JH593Gv4ZDOQM64oMVnD-34ck552i0DQHhSsYnK-7qqtvu-mEYSPn0ryxZBJm7Hm2RRMxnmOHIoM9NvNdIRtrN44gt0_Z5jVQS5REIyA62MD4GE%3D)
---

I knew then that I wanted to do more to help, so I ran for the California State Board of Equalization and then, the Orange County Board of Supervisors. I was the highest-ranking Korean-American elected official in the country.

**I gave almost $400 million back to California taxpayers, and that put a major target on my back.**

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=31e873e4cc484f5dbd91c701e315c76d&_e=d1DmxAEUJlloI9MKUQm05u950rynO3-1KSdGyWzsEAWvHDHdKA08dwkC2iVy0dSfj606XUHR-VuRvSJOepCRRo5_uwS0ILxpoFnIadmNYVor8AHB1R_-F4tygrDujTuolIMchBROsstoBeDCecBxAVBM2MdsXns-d1kRknX2q8Wqbjch1AnNFe1LUZ6OoxA964dACCkzsedj5FYVoyR1u6XdNiz6MQiMg4Q0yExIOHbbbuN6Sp8cuvzL6cA28wYkZp2fxJaaXgkD_c-h3938QCwPo_y7bl3DFZN6ZcMDhWO3a4i5zPAtej-KLSe1eMMNxLjoXbtONfwnPYcvXF8GksXVWuktM7zDUGdG0Kfvq_vqJWxu1jf-bQPGIx17R6cMWsy8onGLGtcfkCiNRVg_s1-XZK7UqZwvqd26892tyHHUMCrIFd1IRE0RmB5AHUhPDNPBQcLAmZzgqlduoO6zwc9FZq4bslycaiEyMG-zFzw%3D)

My race was one of the most hard-fought in the country. Last year was more of the same, but we won again and helped take back the House Majority.

I'll be blunt, Friend, without your support, my campaign is in major trouble. _**[I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can't fight back without your support.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=31e873e4cc484f5dbd91c701e315c76d&_e=d1DmxAEUJlloI9MKUQm05u950rynO3-1KSdGyWzsEAWvHDHdKA08dwkC2iVy0dSfj606XUHR-VuRvSJOepCRRo5_uwS0ILxpoFnIadmNYVor8AHB1R_-F4tygrDujTuolIMchBROsstoBeDCecBxAVBM2MdsXns-d1kRknX2q8Wqbjch1AnNFe1LUZ6OoxA964dACCkzsedj5FYVoyR1u6XdNiz6MQiMg4Q0yExIOHbbbuN6Sp8cuvzL6cA28wYkZp2fxJaaXgkD_c-h3938QCwPo_y7bl3DFZN6ZcMDhWO3a4i5zPAtej-KLSe1eMMNxLjoXbtONfwnPYcvXF8GklCoKmkC5hVldC7DyTsvNvR77WVz784shrNlsWu6WnoiPSVu4wz_Sn3BnUK0VLoBsu3Em7xIh3FtILSB3_iWvsiuxZmZRSmO8zyta34AJSgo0N2jbThlAzBKPYVsLwgZGbWOQUbQnaVyrJDvMDy4n34%3D "I am in the fight of my life in a Biden +6.9 seat, and I can’t fight back without your support.")**_

body:
The WHO Treaty is pending. Who we elect will matter. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/i-will-not-praise-a-lockdown-tyrant?e=5bb5efcda7)

| |

| |
# Why the Right Voice in Congress Matters: W.H.O. Treaty.
,

Who we elect during dark hours of crisis and urgency, as well as in times of sunshine and peace, matters and will directly impact the future of civilization.

I am no sunshine-only patriot.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=246d61989b&e=5bb5efcda7)
As an allied attorney with Alliance Defending Freedom International, I just received an e-mail briefing from my UK friends warning of the pending "WHO Pandemic Treaty" on the near horizon.

This "Treaty" is pending at the World Health Organization and Biden has pledged to sign it and the Senate and Congress will be the deciding vote and voice about ratification.

ADF-UK recently sent warning letters to the U.S. House of Representatives - where I am running to represent you and be your voice - exposing the following about this "treaty":

_"According to a recent draft, the agreement would require parties to “combat false, misleading, misinformation or disinformation, including through effective international collaboration and cooperation”.

It would also go as far as to require parties to manage so-called infodemics, defined as including “too much information”."_ Can you imagine voting for someone who might support or fail to lift a voice and effort to defeat this measure that could give away our national sovereignty over our own bodies and daily lives during declared "emergencies" **\- and silence those who object?**

But that is what District Six could do if they do not ask these tough questions. **_My opponents are each silent on this matter and Neil Parrott went so far as to support a man - Larry Hogan - who supports Pandemic Lockdowns and if elected would therefore be positioned in the Senate to ratify this dangerous and deadly treaty_**.

Who you support now matters for the security of our families. Before any job growth, tax cut, Border security and community peace and opportunity, we must have our freedom. Without freedom, there is no civilization.

Please support my campaign to represent you today. I need your urgent contribution to help me reach at least 50,000 voters in the next two weeks.

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=b23e8edf3e&e=5bb5efcda7)
I know how to lead during dark and intimidating hours when liberty and life is under attack. By God's grace, I stood up as the sole State Delegate to file impeachment papers against the governor who was destroying our Constitution and national security with his illegal COVID executive orders.

I will stand with you and never praise those who would destroy our foundations of freedom and national sovereignty.

Thank you for standing with me today.

Freedom and Victory,

Dan Cox, Candidate for U.S. House of Representatives (R-MD6)

Upon returning from Ukraine, I joined CNN’s Wolf Blitzer to discuss former President Trump’s abhorrent comments about abandoning our NATO allies.

| Peter,

Upon returning from Ukraine, I joined CNN’s Wolf Blitzer to discuss former President Trump’s abhorrent comments about abandoning our NATO allies. **Trump said he’d allow Putin and Russia to “do whatever the hell they want” to our NATO allies.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79532257/456739169/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-02-22_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGMxYWNmZDMtYzJkMS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=U__cKfZBBICgJz8-zvm7wfm4yR1o6Tnv7OL32cKpgdo=)
The former president’s comments endanger our national security and our closest allies’ security.

I traveled to Ukraine with other members of the House Intelligence Committee to meet President Zelenskyy and his leadership team and spend time with U.S. Embassy personnel serving in Kyiv. The visit affirmed what we knew — supporting our ally Ukraine as they fight for their freedom is in our national security interests. Putin will not stop in Ukraine, and the United States must stand steady in the face of threats to democracy at home and abroad.

As a Member of Congress and former CIA officer, I have taken an oath multiple times to protect and defend the Constitution, and I’ve seen how fragile democracy is, especially when extremists are undermining our institutions and sowing distrust.

I’ve committed my life to service and protecting our country, our democracy, and our rights. I want you to know that as Governor of Virginia, I will continue to defend our democracy and uphold our institutions in every way I can.

# Suozzi Swearing-In Tickets
Hi Friend,
Thank you for your unwavering support throughout the campaign. I am so grateful.

My swearing-in will take place around **6:30pm on February 28th in the U.S. Capitol.
**
We will also have a big thank you party in mid-March on the Nassau/Queens border (the invite will come next week).

Tickets to my swearing in at the Capitol are extremely limited, but if you want to try and come down to DC, **please complete**[**this form**](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=34a4811424&e=2d63ff009b)**by Friday, February 23rd at 5:00pm.** If we have a ticket for you, we will get back to you this weekend with additional information.

Best,

Tom Suozzi

subject: re: increasing the minimum wage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee
body:
Everyone deserves a living wage.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79533524/456742907/-849459103?refcode=ea.eb8c6356-c5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ms=ea.eb8c6356-c5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjhjNjM1Ni1jNWQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ds3RoQhGgtqWpC9HPIMQ83butRzwYRtR9VP5WJ5aqes=&emci=f0dac8cc-93d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=eb8c6356-c5d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=46764483)
---
Y’all, I want to take a minute of your time to tell you about one of the pieces of legislation that I introduced in this session of the Tennessee legislature. Right now, Tennessee’s minimum wage is set at the federal standard — $7.25. That’s where it’s been since 2009. It doesn’t make any damn sense. Just think about how much the cost of rent and groceries has gone up since 2009. $7.25 per hour isn’t a living wage here in TN or _anywhere_ in the country.
