[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, the CEOs of
America’s largest corporations make too much money — don’t you think?
Especially compared to the salaries and wages of workers in this country.

Don’t you think Steven Schwarzman, the CEO of Blackstone and a major Trump
donor in 2020, makes too much money? Blackstone paid him $253,122,146 in
2022, over 1,000 times more than the company’s median worker. That’s a lot
of money for Schwarzman to donate to Republican Super PACs.

Don’t you think Michael Rapino, the CEO of Live Nation — 2022 compensation
at $139,005,565 — is making too much money? When Live Nation, who owns
Ticketmaster, slaps you with outrageous, bogus fees to go see a concert,
comedy show, or sporting event, Rapino is making millions. And he makes
5,414x the average Live Nation worker.

We definitely think these CEOs are making too much money. That’s why we’re
all-in behind the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act, legislation that would either
punish corporations with a higher tax bill for paying CEOs so much or
force them to raise the pay of their workers.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14958?source=email-20240222&t=1011&akid=5362%2E5885482%2E1Q1j_6 ]Add your name: Join progressive lawmakers right now in showing support
for the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act right now!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14958?source=email-20240222&t=1012&akid=5362%2E5885482%2E1Q1j_6 ]ADD YOUR NAME

“Corporate greed is a disease,” Rep. Rashida Tlaib said as progressives
introduced this bill a few weeks ago. “It’s disgraceful that corporations
continue to rake in record profits by exploiting the labor of their
workers. Working families deserve to live with human dignity.”

If the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act had been in effect in 2022, corporations
like McDonald’s, Nike, Walmart, JP Morgan Chase, and Google would’ve had
to pay billions more in taxes.

Millionaires and billionaires don’t need higher salaries. Workers need
better pay so they can afford rent, mortgages, daycare, groceries,
medications, and more. That’s why this bill, which targets the massive
income and wealth inequality in America, is so important. It’s time for
the richest people in this country to pay their fair share in taxes.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: It was never just about Roe
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1160%2E135344%2EMVA2fF)

This week, the Alabama Supreme Court ruled that frozen IVF embryos are legally considered children, and disposing of them could lead to being charged with “wrongful death of a minor.”
Let’s break it down: For decades now, in vitro fertilization (IVF) has been used by people with fertility issues to grow their families. Typically, doctors will create and implant multiple embryos because the odds of resulting in a pregnancy are not guaranteed. Therefore, IVF treatments often result in additional frozen embryos that are not implanted to be kept viable for future use.
The results of such a ruling are already playing out in Alabama: Fertility clinics in Alabama have already halted treatments of couples desperate to have children out of concern for criminal prosecution. This is what happens when people who don’t know what they’re talking about make policy around women’s health.
It’s also another example of the salami tactics we’ve seen the Republican Party use for decades, as the anti-choice movement slowly chipped away at the federal right to abortion, until it was completely gone -- supposedly leaving the issue to the states. Since then, the Republican-led House has tee’d up multiple votes meant to shut down some form of abortion access, and states like Alabama and Texas are setting new precedents for other states to follow.
In June, we will see another landmark case at the Supreme Court that could ban the mailing of mifepristone across state lines -- a safe and legal drug that has been widely used for over two decades -- significantly limiting access to care even where abortion is legal.
So we should be clear that for the movement against choice, it was never just about sending abortion to the states. It was never even just about abortion.
These decisions are as personal as they come, whether it’s the choice to terminate a pregnancy or to go through painful and expensive treatments to realize a family’s dreams of a baby. The Alabama Supreme Court — and the asinine leaders who don’t understand women’s health issues — don’t belong anywhere near these decisions.
We know where the average American is on this issue: Michiganders of all stripes voted overwhelmingly to codify reproductive freedom in our constitution last November. It’s GOP politicians, obsessed with imposing their views on everyone else, who are leading our country backwards and making this country less and less safe for women and girls.
And if they are able to defeat us in November, they may get their wish.
[**Will you stand with me in the fight for reproductive freedom?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240222-2-15&t=2&akid=1160%2E135344%2EMVA2fF)**

clean_body: If we want to continue to make progress on gun safety reform, reproductive rights, and more this November, we need to ensure that PA stays BLUE. | = | Peter, In case you missed it, Donald Trump has made a few campaign visits to my home state of Pennsylvania this month. Included in his stops was a speech at the National Rifle Association where he promised the "Second Amendment will always be safe with me as your president." This underscores just one of the many things that are at stake this November. President Biden passed one of the most comprehensive gun safety reform bills in the last 30 years with bipartisan support. If we want to continue to make progress on gun safety reform, reproductive rights, and more this November, we need to ensure that PA stays BLUE. body:
Hi Peter, it’s Angela.

I normally try to keep my emails on the shorter side, but this is a long
one.

In my defense, I have a lot to say! I’ve outlined some of my key
priorities in this campaign and our fight to build a better Maryland. So,
if you can, I hope you take a few moments to read it through!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12231?t=1007&amount=25&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ]But if you’re in a hurry, you can support my campaign for the U.S.
Senate here, then come back and read this whenever you’ve got some extra
time!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12231?t=1008&amount=25&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ]Donate

Put People First

This campaign isn’t about Angela. It’s about you – the people of Maryland
– and the issues that you care about most.

Putting people first on the campaign trail looks like: Listening instead
of just talking, having face-to-face conversations, and meeting
Marylanders where they are (whether that’s Wegmans, at your front door, or
just out on the sidewalk!).

In the Senate, putting people first means standing up to those who
undermine the health and safety of our communities. It means making sure
that Marylanders can live, work, learn, and prosper in the state we call
home.

That’s been my mission since I entered public service nearly thirty years
ago. I won’t back down now.

Lead from Experience

I believe that Marylanders deserve a Senator who’s walked a mile or two in
their shoes.

I understand firsthand the problems faced by regular Marylanders, because
I am one – unlike my multi-millionaire opponent!

I grew up in a working-class home. My parents taught us to look after our
neighbors and give back to our community.

And as a working mom, I’ve experienced challenges shared by so many
families. I know what it’s like to worry about affordable childcare,
public safety, and high-quality education. I know the enormous value of a
supportive and close-knit community.

I’ve been there. Those experiences got me into public service in the first
place, and they’re the reason I’m still fighting to improve education,
expand economic opportunities, and ensure working Marylanders have the
tools they need to thrive.

Tackle the Issues That Matter, Big or Small

Maryland is made up of so many diverse communities. As a public servant,
it’s my responsibility to understand the unique issues each one faces.

For some, those are big-picture issues like climate change, affordable
healthcare, or abortion rights.

Others are concerned about issues that don’t always make headlines, like
flood readiness, broadband access, and clean water; veterans’ benefits;
recycling programs; treatment for substance abuse and mental health; and
addressing historic inequality.

On hot-button and obscure policy issues alike, these issues matter to me
because they matter to you. Together, we’ll confront the obstacles that
hold us back. We’ll go farther and do better for Maryland.

Wow, Peter! I said at the beginning of this email that it’d be a
long one – I wasn’t lying!

If you’ve made it this far, thank you.

I just have to make one final request.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12231?t=1009&amount=25&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ]I need to overcome my opponent’s massive spending and win this
ultra-competitive primary before I get to work for Maryland families in
the Senate. Can I count on you to chip in $25 to help me pull ahead?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12231?t=1010&amount=25&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ]Donate $25

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12231?t=1011&amount=35&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ]Donate more

So gratefully,

Angela

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/89?t=1001&akid=1105%2E52803%2EI0xCZL ][IMG]

We believe that emails are the best way for our organization to stay in
touch with supporters like you. But if you'd like to receive fewer emails,

Non-governmental organizations (NGOs) are making BILLIONS off of the trafficking of the same folks.

Fox News just released some daunting statistics: nearly **7.3 million migrants have illegally crossed our southern border under Biden 's watch. That's greater than the population of 37 individual states.** It's more than two years of native births on U.S. soil . . . even if you include the 250,000 or more "anchor babies" born here each year.

It's not "coyotes" moving 7.2 million bodies across the border. That's laughable.

There's an organized industry to facilitate a constant flow of immigrants across our border and then foster, employ, and house immigrants after they illegally cross the border. There are even free law firms to help them gain citizenship after five years of refugee status.

We're talking billions of dollars in costs. Where is that money coming from?

It's not coming just from immigrants. It's coming from the United Nations, the European Union, and our federal, state, and local governments. Even Medicaid and Medicare are being taken advantage of to put money in the pocket of the immigration industry.

The more bodies, the more profits to the industry . . . and the higher cost to taxpayers.

I'm shining a light on the illegal immigration industry, and so far, they have been scattering. What started with a tip from a worker at the American Airlines counter at Sky Harbor Airport turned into the latest investigation requiring heavy security and the extraction of one of our informants who had guns drawn on him while being held by the "humanitarian non-profit program" called No Mas Muertes in their secret desert camp by the Arizona border.

Our nation stands at a critical juncture, where the very essence of democracy and free speech hangs in the balance.
Individuals like Daniel Ellsberg, John Kiriakou, Chelsea Manning, Edward Snowden, and Julian Assange have bravely exposed government corruption, shedding light on injustices that threaten the core principles of our society.
_But instead of honoring these truth-tellers, our government has chosen to persecute them._
As a staunch advocate for freedom of speech and transparency, I am reaching out to you today with an urgent plea: [join us in demanding the immediate release of Julian Assange.](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_22_24_em1_nd3&n=6)
Julian Assange, a journalist and publisher, has languished behind bars for 13 years for his role in uncovering the truth about governmental wrongdoings, from torture at Guantanamo Bay to anti-democratic actions by the DNC.
It's a travesty that exposing crimes has become a greater offense than the crimes themselves. [We cannot allow this injustice to continue.](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_22_24_em1_nd3&n=7)

_On my first day in office, I pledge to pardon Julian Assange and launch a thorough investigation into the corruption and crimes he has exposed._ Additionally, I will issue an executive order to put an end to any attempts by federal agencies to silence political speech.
But I cannot do this alone. I need your support.
[By signing our petition](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_2_22_24_em1_nd3&n=9), you'll join a chorus of voices demanding justice for Assange and protection for whistleblowers everywhere.
Together, we can ensure that the voices of truth are heard and that those who dare to speak out against injustice are not silenced.
_Please take a moment to add your name to our petition and share it with your friends, family, and colleagues._ Every signature brings us one step closer to securing Julian Assange's freedom and safeguarding our fundamental rights.
Thank you for your unwavering commitment to justice and liberty.

subject: Our natural world is under assault
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jeff Merkley for Oregon
body:
Fortunately, the beauty of a free press in a democracy is that the press shines a light on these issues, and legislators have the opportunity to address them.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79539192/456761822/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGRjOThhOC1kNmQxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3HQEgeB4NMsmqRUMmeLDV0oYdkP8RLDsaQ4m1PjXerk=&emci=50053938-b6d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=50dc98a8-d6d1-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=7731215)

| | Our natural world is under assault from many directions, including plastics, urban sprawl, and climate change. Fortunately, the beauty of a free press in a democracy is that the press shines a light on these issues, and legislators have the opportunity to address them. It is essential that Congress tackle these emerging challenges, and here are some of the ways I'm fighting to do so: **FIRST: Let's start with plastics. They are damaging the environment as lumps of plastic that harm wildlife to microplastics and nanoplastics polluting our air, land, and water.** Last year I held the Senate's first ever series of hearings on plastic pollution. I filed the "Break Free From Plastic Pollution Act" with a comprehensive plan to tackle plastic pollution. And I put directions into the Department of Interior funding bill to eliminate plastic bottles in national parks. **SECOND****: I made sure the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law provided funding to support cleanup at abandoned mines like the Formosa Mine Superfund site near Riddle, OR.** Abandoned mines have been poisoning our waters for years, and they won't get cleaned up without funding to do so. **THIRD: I introduced a resolution in the Senate to establish a National Biodiversity Strategy.** We need smart, well-coordinated efforts across all levels of government, business, and community leadership to preserve biodiversity for future generations. Without species biodiversity, life on our planet cannot function properly. **FOURTH: I directed funding to programs that help save endangered species**. One is a breeding program for the magnificent California condors (9-ft wingspans!) operated by the Oregon Zoo. Another is a program to save the Western monarchs, which have seen a 95% population decline over 25 years. **FIFTH: I pressed for the completion of a management plan for Oregon's Cascade-Siskiyou National Monument, which I successfully doubled in size in 2017.** The CSNM is a biodiversity paradise with over 100 species of butterflies! **SIXTH: I led several battles in the effort to replace fossil energy with renewable energy — but that merits an additional email!** I'll keep fighting for Mother Earth, both for the health and enjoyment of this generation and the generations to come. I need you to help me keep pushing Congress to make addressing the conservation of our natural spaces a national priority. clean_body: Fortunately, the beauty of a free press in a democracy is that the press shines a light on these issues, and legislators have the opportunity to address them. | | | | Our natural world is under assault from many directions, including plastics, urban sprawl, and climate change. Fortunately, the beauty of a free press in a democracy is that the press shines a light on these issues, and legislators have the opportunity to address them. It is essential that Congress tackle these emerging challenges, and here are some of the ways I'm fighting to do so: FIRST: Let's start with plastics. They are damaging the environment as lumps of plastic that harm wildlife to microplastics and nanoplastics polluting our air, land, and water. Last year I held the Senate's first ever series of hearings on plastic pollution. I filed the "Break Free From Plastic Pollution Act" with a comprehensive plan to tackle plastic pollution. And I put directions into the Department of Interior funding bill to eliminate plastic bottles in national parks. SECOND: I made sure the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law provided funding to support cleanup at abandoned mines like the Formosa Mine Superfund site near Riddle, OR. Abandoned mines have been poisoning our waters for years, and they won't get cleaned up without funding to do so. THIRD: I introduced a resolution in the Senate to establish a National Biodiversity Strategy. We need smart, well-coordinated efforts across all levels of government, business, and community leadership to preserve biodiversity for future generations. Without species biodiversity, life on our planet cannot function properly. FOURTH: I directed funding to programs that help save endangered species. One is a breeding program for the magnificent California condors (9-ft wingspans!) operated by the Oregon Zoo. Another is a program to save the Western monarchs, which have seen a 95% population decline over 25 years. FIFTH: I pressed for the completion of a management plan for Oregon's Cascade-Siskiyou National Monument, which I successfully doubled in size in 2017. The CSNM is a biodiversity paradise with over 100 species of butterflies! SIXTH: I led several battles in the effort to replace fossil energy with renewable energy — but that merits an additional email! I'll keep fighting for Mother Earth, both for the health and enjoyment of this generation and the generations to come. I need you to help me keep pushing Congress to make addressing the conservation of our natural spaces a national priority. Together, we can get it done and protect our environment and natural world that makes our country a better, more beautiful place. Onward! name: Dr. Brian Williams
subject: A moment that forever changed the course of the Civil Rights Movement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Brian Williams for Congress
body:
| | Peter,

Today, I reflect on a defining moment in the civil rights movement — **the Montgomery Bus Boycotts.**

I’m grateful for the courage of civil rights leaders like Rosa Parks, who stood against injustice and cleared a path for future generations. Ms. Parks showed the power of one. How one decision by one person in one moment can ignite a collective movement for change. She refused to accept the status quo and sparked a wave of courage and determination that resonated far beyond Montgomery.

I’ve spent my life navigating a world that treats me differently because of my skin color. Racism is an ever-present reminder that the fight to create a society that values, supports, and protects everyone is far from over. Together, we must acknowledge and dismantle systemic injustices that still persist. Let us draw inspiration from the heroes of the civil rights movement and continue their work for justice. Their sacrifices and determination paved the way for progress, but there is still much work to do.

TX-32 is a majority-minority district, and the importance of diverse representation in Congress must be celebrated. For those who feel excluded from the political process, diverse leadership is the inspiration to motivate an engaged and excited electorate. I am the leader who will champion the values, experiences, and needs of all members of TX-32.

When elected, I pledge to be a voice for the marginalized, a champion for the underrepresented, and a tireless advocate for justice. Together, we can build a future where every citizen, regardless of their background, is valued, respected, and empowered. Imagine the heartbreak that so many women and families must feel: after struggling to conceive or experiencing miscarriage, taking daily shots, and spending thousands of dollars, their path to potentially having a baby has been thrown into uncertainty by political extremists. This ruling reflects a broader trend of extreme Republicans seeking to undermine our rights and the dignity of women everywhere. body:
We need your voice to re-elect Alexandria.
#
Big news: **today, we’re officially kicking off Alexandria’s 2024 reelection campaign!**
And we need your help to build the powerful momentum it will take to keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for our communities. Since day one, our campaign has been defined by people-power. **That’s why we’re asking for you to lend us your most powerful resource today:_your voice_.**
[Will you take a moment to endorse AOC, and share with us why, today? Your commitment will show Republicans and corporate Democrats alike that AOC is here to stay »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/endorse-aoc-2024/?source=em20240222-5865-P_FND_EVT_GOL&t=1&akid=5865%2E2526796%2EE-11W7)
**[Endorse AOC »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/endorse-aoc-2024/?source=em20240222-5865-P_FND_EVT_GOL&t=2&akid=5865%2E2526796%2EE-11W7)**
In 2018, we beat a machine with a movement. In 2020, our movement defeated millions in corporate and special interest dollars. In 2022, together we won out over the disinformation and outright lies of a MAGA challenger. **This year, we can take nothing for granted.**
Movements like ours are targeted by million dollar attack ads simply because Alexandria stands up for working families, not special interests.
Endorsing Alexandria isn’t just an endorsement of a candidate — **it’s an endorsement of Medicare for All, a livable minimum wage, a Green New Deal, and a movement for transformative change in our country**. And that has an impact.
When other members of Congress see thousands of grassroots activists — like you, like everyone reading this — standing together, they are enticed to join us.
[So will you take a moment to give us your grassroots endorsement right now, and tell the entire nation that you stand with AOC?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/endorse-aoc-2024/?source=em20240222-5865-P_FND_EVT_GOL&t=3&akid=5865%2E2526796%2EE-11W7)
Thank you for everything.
Pa’lante,
Team AOC

subject: Our rights are on the line.
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQWZDEf3BtkGLSRlQwg6iZZJEpTRisNg3Nackob_0D9Mp&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022224_abortion_rights&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, It's clear where we are headed, and I'll be damned if I sit quietly while right-wing extremists continue to strip away reproductive freedom and our right to decide if, when, and how we become parents. **Across the country, they are dismantling our fundamental right to bodily autonomy. From the Alabama Supreme Court ruling that embryos created via IVF are “children,” to states criminalizing aiding and abetting abortion care.** People who can get pregnant and those who love and support them are under attack. But the real kicker? If Trump gets back in office and we don't lock down the Senate, our right to make our own decisions about our bodies are as good as gone. And it ain't just about being a Democrat, we’ve seen what voting for just any old Democrat gets us. **This is about having the courage of your conviction and the willingness to stand up and fight back against a coordinated attack on our right to make our own reproductive health decisions.** We are at a critical moment: MAGA Republicans are promising a 16-week national abortion ban if they win in November like it is some kind of compromise. You know what? Abortion rights are not up for negotiation for me. **We need to go beyond Roe;****because _Roe v Wade_ was always the floor.****We need to codify the right to legal abortion, eliminate the discriminatory Hyde Amendment, and increase funding for reproductive health care including abortion.** Every person should have equitable, affordable access to the full-range of sexual and reproductive healthcare including abortion, on the timeline they need it, and in the communities they trust. Period. I'm running because we need Senators who are willing to stand up for abortion access. We can't afford to sit back and hope for the best. It's time to get fired up to make sure we're not just electing Democrats but electing fighters who won't back down when our rights are on the line. This isn't about money or campaigns right now. It's about standing together, shoulder to shoulder, and fighting for our rights. We have to make sure everyone knows what's at stake and get every last person out to vote like our lives depend on it - because they do. They won’t stop at a 16-week ban just like they didn’t stop at Roe. **[We're in this together. Let's show 'em what we're made of and take this fight to the ballot box. For our rights, for our lives, and for our future.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQWZDEf3BtkGLSRlQwg6iZZJEpTRisNg3Nackob_0D9Mp&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022224_abortion_rights&n=2)** In solidarity, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate

Jon Tester is in the fight of his life to protect Montana’s Senate seat and defend the Democratic majority. **If we lose Montana, Democrats can K-I-S-S their majority goodbye! **

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**

We hope you’ll consider contributing today to help us defeat MAGA extremist Anthony D’Esposito and flip this seat blue. | = To: Peter From: Sarah Carlson, Campaign Manager, Laura Gillen for Congress Re: NY-04 State of the Race Memo Date: February 22, 2024 Here’s an important update on how we can flip the most flippable Congressional race in New York: Laura is the best candidate to represent NY-04: Laura knows first-hand the challenges facing New York families and has an impactful record of service to this community. Laura will fight in Congress to make our communities more affordable, protect women's right to bodily autonomy, secure the border, and pass common-sense gun safety legislation. She’ll be a champion for our district in Congress. We need your support to elect Laura to represent NY-04. A strong foundation to build on: Congressman-elect Suozzi’s victory is an exciting indication that Democrats can win again on Long Island. Like Suozzi, Laura has a bipartisan record of delivering results. In Congress, she will work on affordability, protecting reproductive rights, and stand up to Republican extremism. We’re now the #1 target: Republican Super PACs are gearing up to spend millions of dollars to protect their razor-thin majority, hitting the airwaves to protect MAGA extremist Anthony D’Esposito. Political Experts at The Cook Political Report and Sabato’s Crystal Ball both rated this race as a toss-up. We need to close the fundraising gap and amplify our campaign to flip this most winnable seat. Our campaign is powered by grassroots supporters like you, and we need your help to win this race and take back the Democratic House Majority. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = – Sarah Carlson, Campaign Manager, Laura Gillen for Congress | | = Paid for and authorized by Gillen for NY.
